- **Title**: fix(1622): shell_job_registry persist window strands live jobs off the record on crash
- **Author**: vabhzw17eg2qu4m9-bit
- **Branch**: `fix/1622-job-board-restart-lost-count` → `main`
- **State**: open
- **Files Changed**: 3
- **Additions**: +117
- **Deletions**: -9
- **Created**: 2026-10-15T04:09:00Z
- **Updated**: 2026-10-15T04:18:06Z

## PR Description

## Problem
Nightly PTY red: `test/integration/job_board_stability_pty_test.dart:420` "restart with live jobs shows lost, never running" expects `5 background tasks lost`, got `✗ 1 background task lost on restart (process gone, no exit reported)` (run 38676570867, main 28927a1b0f). Green in the Oct-13/14 nightlies.

## Root cause
Culprit: 872f3ccc47 (gh-1590/#1594 — session JSONL diet). Its `LedgerSnapshotThrottle` (30 s `ledgerSnapshotPersistInterval`) rate-bounds `shell_job_registry` appends in `_persistJobBoard`: only the first board mutation in a window appends; the rest coalesce behind a trailing flush (real 30 s Timer) or the graceful shutdown flush. A SIGKILL runs neither. The PTY scenario launches 5 jobs inside one window then `hardKill`s — the file's last snapshot carries only job 1, so `_rehydrateJobBoard` demotes 1 live card to lost. Not a compaction/repair eviction: `repairKeepLatestCustomTypes` and the resume-time reader keep the LATEST snapshot; the records never reached the file. Pre-#1594 every mutation appended, which is why the baseline was green.

## Fix
Live-set GROWTH (a job started) bypasses the persist window — each start appends immediately, so the last snapshot always carries every started job and the invariant `lost == seeded live` holds. Settles keep riding the window: an unpersisted settle only overcounts `lost` on a crash (conservative — still never "running"). # pr-1623: fix(1622): shell_job_registry persist window strands live jobs off the record on crash

## Description

## Problem
Nightly PTY red: `test/integration/job_board_stability_pty_test.dart:420` "restart with live jobs shows lost, never running" expects `5 background tasks lost`, got `✗ 1 background task lost on restart (process gone, no exit reported)` (run 38676570867, main 28927a1b0f). Green in the Oct-13/14 nightlies.

## Root cause
Culprit: 872f3ccc47 (gh-1590/#1594 — session JSONL diet). Its `LedgerSnapshotThrottle` (30 s `ledgerSnapshotPersistInterval`) rate-bounds `shell_job_registry` appends in `_persistJobBoard`: only the first board mutation in a window appends; the rest coalesce behind a trailing flush (real 30 s Timer) or the graceful shutdown flush. A SIGKILL runs neither. The PTY scenario launches 5 jobs inside one window then `hardKill`s — the file's last snapshot carries only job 1, so `_rehydrateJobBoard` demotes 1 live card to lost. Not a compaction/repair eviction: `repairKeepLatestCustomTypes` and the resume-time reader keep the LATEST snapshot; the records never reached the file. Pre-#1594 every mutation appended, which is why the baseline was green.

## Fix
Live-set GROWTH (a job started) bypasses the persist window — each start appends immediately, so the last snapshot always carries every started job and the invariant `lost == seeded live` holds. Settles keep riding the window: an unpersisted settle only overcounts `lost` on a crash (conservative — still never "running"). The gh-1590 diet stays in force for terminal churn; its wiring-test pin is revised to `<= starts + 1` with rationale.

# Pull Request Information

- **PR #**: 1623
- **URL**: https://github.com/IstiN/flutter_agent_harness/pull/1623
- **Title**: fix(1622): shell_job_registry persist window strands live jobs off the record on crash
- **Author**: vabhzw17eg2qu4m9-bit
- **Branch**: `fix/1622-job-board-restart-lost-count` → `main`
- **State**: open
- **Files Changed**: 3
- **Additions**: +117
- **Deletions**: -9
- **Created**: 2026-10-15T04:09:00Z
- **Updated**: 2026-10-15T04:18:06Z

## PR Description

## Problem
Nightly PTY red: `test/integration/job_board_stability_pty_test.dart:420` "restart with live jobs shows lost, never running" expects `5 background tasks lost`, got `✗ 1 background task lost on restart (process gone, no exit reported)` (run 38676570867, main 28927a1b0f). Green in the Oct-13/14 nightlies.

## Root cause
Culprit: 872f3ccc47 (gh-1590/#1594 — session JSONL diet). Its `LedgerSnapshotThrottle` (30 s `ledgerSnapshotPersistInterval`) rate-bounds `shell_job_registry` appends in `_persistJobBoard`: only the first board mutation in a window appends; the rest coalesce behind a trailing flush (real 30 s Timer) or the graceful shutdown flush. A SIGKILL runs neither. The PTY scenario launches 5 jobs inside one window then `hardKill`s — the file's last snapshot carries only job 1, so `_rehydrateJobBoard` demotes 1 live card to lost. Not a compaction/repair eviction: `repairKeepLatestCustomTypes` and the resume-time reader keep the LATEST snapshot; the records never reached the file. Pre-#1594 every mutation appended, which is why the baseline was green.

## Fix
Live-set GROWTH (a job started) bypasses the persist window — each start appends immediately, so the last snapshot always carries every started job and the invariant `lost == seeded live` holds. Settles keep riding the window: an unpersisted settle only overcounts `lost` on a crash (conservative — still never "running"). The gh-1590 diet stays in force for terminal churn; its wiring-test pin is revised to `<= starts + 1` with rationale.

## Gates
- `dart analyze` clean on touched files (lib/src/cli/agent_cli.dart, lib/src/cli/agent_hub_cli.dart, test/cli/shell_job_ledger_throttle_wiring_test.dart); `dart format` applied.
- `test/cli/shell_job_ledger_throttle_wiring_test.dart` 3/3 green, incl. a new crash-moment regression test (real AgentCli, frozen `ledgerClock`: at the SIGKILL-equivalent point the session file must already carry all 5 jobs as running). Verified the new test FAILS pre-fix (lib change stashed) and passes post-fix.
- `shell_job_ledger_caps_test.dart` + `subagent_registry_caps_test.dart` 18/18 green.
- The PTY repro itself needs a real pty (`openpty` is blocked in this dev sandbox) — CI nightly is its gate.

Closes #1622

AGENTS.md
# AGENTS.md

Conventions for AI agents and contributors in this repository. Keep it
factual: paths, commands, invariants — no essays.

## Project layout

- `lib/` — the `flutter_agent_harness` package (pure Dart core). `test/`
  mirrors it. `prompts/` — all LLM prompts as Markdown (see rules below).
- `lib/flutter_agent_harness.dart` (the barrel) — gh-1232 policy:
  GROUPED APPEND-ONLY export sections, one `// ── <subsystem> ──` comment
  header per group, exports sorted by path within a group, new exports
  appended to their subsystem group (a new subsystem starts a new group).
  No per-subsystem mini-barrels, no re-sorting of existing lines — append
  only, so parallel edits almost never touch the same line.
- God-file ceiling (gh-1232): no Dart file over 2800 lines anywhere
  (crap4dart `loc` gate, `max_lines: 2800` — issue #1234 migrated the
  shell guards; enforced whole-tree in CI and on staged files by the
  pre-commit hook. Scope: core `lib bin` via `crap4dart.yaml` +
  `test example` via the `crap4dart.loc-scope.yaml` companion config
  (0.11.0 has no per-gate sources override), flutter_app/lib via
  `flutter_app/crap4dart.yaml`).
  Target < 2000 for primary
  files; when a file approaches it, split by concern into `part` files
  (the established pattern: `agent_cli.dart`, `builtin_tools.dart`,
  `bin/fah.dart` → `bin/fah_*.dart`, `agent_service.dart` →
  `agent_service_*.dart` mixins) — never by extracting public API.
- `lib/src/approval/` — tool approval gate: tiers (read/write/exec),
  session modes (always-ask/write/yolo/autopilot — the CLI label of the
  `unattended` enum), per-tool overrides,
  critical-pattern
  `bash` interceptor, per-turn grants (`grantForTurn(allow:, deny:)` —
  skill `allowed-tools`/`disallowed-tools` manifest keys ride these for one
  turn; explicit deny > turnDeny > per-tool override > turnAllow >
  alwaysAllow > mode (critical bash outranks mode in always-ask/write/yolo,
  but is skipped in unattended so the mode never blocks — for runs with no
  user present); `clearTurnGrants()`
  on every new user
  message). Wired via `attachApproval` into `beforeToolCall` (runs
  first); prompt UI is an injectable `ApprovalPrompt` (null + prompt policy
  = deny).
- `lib/src/tools/ask_tool.dart` — `ask` tool: structured mid-turn questions
  via injectable `AskCallback` (null = error, cancel = plain result).
- `lib/src/tools/request_secret_tool.dart` — `request_secret` tool: the agent

  `RequestSecretResult` (host-adjusted `name`, `value`, `persisted` flag),

re-read changed files,
surface ALL remaining issues"] EXHAUST --> OUTPUT["8. Write outputs:
pr_review.json · pr_review_general.md · pr_review_comments/*.md"] OUTPUT --> END([End]) ``` ## 1. Input context — MANDATORY reading order ```mermaid flowchart TD subgraph PR_CONTEXT["⚠️ PR-specific files (read first)"] P1["1️⃣ instruction.md (repo root) — project stack, conventions"] P2["2️⃣ input/TICKET/pr_info.md — PR title, author, branch, description"] P3["3️⃣ input/TICKET/pr_diff.txt — the diff to review"] P4["4️⃣ input/TICKET/pr_files.txt — list of changed files"] P5["5️⃣ input/TICKET/ci_failures.md — CI failures = BLOCKING (last 500 lines)"] P5_FULL["5️⃣ input/TICKET/ci_failures_full.log — full CI logs"] P6["6️⃣ input/TICKET/pr_discussions.md + pr_discussions_raw.json — existing comments"] P1 --> P2 --> P3 --> P4 --> P5 --> P5_FULL --> P6 end subgraph TICKET_CONTEXT["Ticket context (for understanding PR purpose)"] T1["7️⃣ input/TICKET/ticket.md — linked ticket description, ACs"] T2["8️⃣ input/TICKET/comments.md — ticket discussion if present"] T3["9️⃣ input/TICKET/parent-*.md — parent story context"] T4["🔟 input/TICKET/confluence/*.md — linked specifications"] T1 --> T2 --> T3 --> T4 end subgraph RULE["⚠️ Rule"] R1["If file exists in input/ → read locally, do NOT re-fetch via dmtools"] end PR_CONTEXT --> TICKET_CONTEXT --> RULE ``` Read PR files to understand WHAT changed. Read ticket files to understand WHY it changed and verify against requirements. ## 2. Diff checklist — apply to `pr_diff.txt` For every hunk, ask at least these questions: - [ ] Does the change match the ticket scope? Does not block merge. When in doubt, start one level higher; downgrade only after confirming the risk is negligible. ## 7. Exhaustive single-pass review Treat **every** review as the final and only review pass. The author will not get another chance to catch missed findings cheaply. - Do not defer SUGGESTION or IMPORTANT items to a later round because a BLOCKING issue exists. - After classifying all findings, re-read every changed file and ask: *"What else is improvable here?"* - Before writing outputs, verify that no obvious quality, maintainability, or correctness issue was left unreported. - Aim to surface the maximum number of actionable findings in this single iteration. ## 8. # Pull Request Information

- **PR #**: 1623
- **URL**: https://github.com/IstiN/flutter_agent_harness/pull/1623
- **Title**: fix(1622): shell_job_registry persist window strands live jobs off the record on crash
- **Author**: vabhzw17eg2qu4m9-bit
- **Branch**: `fix/1622-job-board-restart-lost-count` → `main`
- **State**: open
- **Files Changed**: 3
- **Additions**: +117
- **Deletions**: -9
- **Created**: 2026-10-15T04:09:00Z
- **Updated**: 2026-10-15T04:18:06Z

## PR Description

## Problem
Nightly PTY red: `test/integration/job_board_stability_pty_test.dart:420` "restart with live jobs shows lost, never running" expects `5 background tasks lost`, got `✗ 1 background task lost on restart (process gone, no exit reported)` (run 38676570867, main 28927a1b0f). Green in the Oct-13/14 nightlies.

## Root cause
Culprit: 872f3ccc47 (gh-1590/#1594 — session JSONL diet). Its `LedgerSnapshotThrottle` (30 s `ledgerSnapshotPersistInterval`) rate-bounds `shell_job_registry` appends in `_persistJobBoard`: only the first board mutation in a window appends; the rest coalesce behind a trailing flush (real 30 s Timer) or the graceful shutdown flush. A SIGKILL runs neither. The PTY scenario launches 5 jobs inside one window then `hardKill`s — the file's last snapshot carries only job 1, so `_rehydrateJobBoard` demotes 1 live card to lost. Not a compaction/repair eviction: `repairKeepLatestCustomTypes` and the resume-time reader keep the LATEST snapshot; the records never reached the file. Pre-#1594 every mutation appended, which is why the baseline was green.

## Fix
Live-set GROWTH (a job started) bypasses the persist window — each start appends immediately, so the last snapshot always carries every started job and the invariant `lost == seeded live` holds. Settles keep riding the window: an unpersisted settle only overcounts `lost` on a crash (conservative — still never "running"). The gh-1590 diet stays in force for terminal churn; its wiring-test pin is revised to `<= starts + 1` with rationale.

## Gates
- `dart analyze` clean on touched files (lib/src/cli/agent_cli.dart, lib/src/cli/agent_hub_cli.dart, test/cli/shell_job_ledger_throttle_wiring_test.dart); `dart format` applied.
- `test/cli/shell_job_ledger_throttle_wiring_test.dart` 3/3 green, incl. a new crash-moment regression test (real AgentCli, frozen `ledgerClock`: at the SIGKILL-equivalent point the session file must already carry all 5 jobs as running). Verified the new test FAILS pre-fix (lib change stashed) and passes post-fix.
- `shell_job_ledger_caps_test.dart` + `subagent_registry_caps_test.dart` 18/18 green.
- The PTY repro itself needs a real pty (`openpty` is blocked in this dev sandbox) — CI nightly is its gate.

Closes #1622

# AGENTS.md

Conventions for AI agents and contributors in this repository. Keep it
factual: paths, commands, invariants — no essays.

## Project layout

- `lib/` — the `flutter_agent_harness` package (pure Dart core). `test/`
  mirrors it. `prompts/` — all LLM prompts as Markdown (see rules below).
- `lib/flutter_agent_harness.dart` (the barrel) — gh-1232 policy:
  GROUPED APPEND-ONLY export sections, one `// ── <subsystem> ──` comment
  header per group, exports sorted by path within a group, new exports
  appended to their subsystem group (a new subsystem starts a new group).
  No per-subsystem mini-barrels, no re-sorting of existing lines — append
  only, so parallel edits almost never touch the same line.
- God-file ceiling (gh-1232): no Dart file over 2800 lines anywhere
  (crap4dart `loc` gate, `max_lines: 2800` — issue #1234 migrated the
  shell guards; enforced whole-tree in CI and on staged files by the
  pre-commit hook. Scope: core `lib bin` via `crap4dart.yaml` +
  `test example` via the `crap4dart.loc-scope.yaml` companion config
  (0.11.0 has no per-gate sources override), flutter_app/lib via
  `flutter_app/crap4dart.yaml`).
  Target < 2000 for primary
  files; when a file approaches it, split by concern into `part` files
  (the established pattern: `agent_cli.dart`, `builtin_tools.dart`,
  `bin/fah.dart` → `bin/fah_*.dart`, `agent_service.dart` →
  `agent_service_*.dart` mixins) — never by extracting public API.

- **Title**: fix(1622): shell_job_registry persist window strands live jobs off the record on crash
- **Author**: vabhzw17eg2qu4m9-bit
- **Branch**: `fix/1622-job-board-restart-lost-count` → `main`
- **State**: open
- **Files Changed**: 3
- **Additions**: +117
- **Deletions**: -9
- **Created**: 2026-10-15T04:09:00Z
- **Updated**: 2026-10-15T04:18:06Z

## PR Description

## Problem
Nightly PTY red: `test/integration/job_board_stability_pty_test.dart:420` "restart with live jobs shows lost, never running" expects `5 background tasks lost`, got `✗ 1 background task lost on restart (process gone, no exit reported)` (run 38676570867, main 28927a1b0f). Green in the Oct-13/14 nightlies.

## Root cause
Culprit: 872f3ccc47 (gh-1590/#1594 — session JSONL diet). Its `LedgerSnapshotThrottle` (30 s `ledgerSnapshotPersistInterval`) rate-bounds `shell_job_registry` appends in `_persistJobBoard`: only the first board mutation in a window appends; the rest coalesce behind a trailing flush (real 30 s Timer) or the graceful shutdown flush. A SIGKILL runs neither. The PTY scenario launches 5 jobs inside one window then `hardKill`s — the file's last snapshot carries only job 1, so `_rehydrateJobBoard` demotes 1 live card to lost. Not a compaction/repair eviction: `repairKeepLatestCustomTypes` and the resume-time reader keep the LATEST snapshot; the records never reached the file. Pre-#1594 every mutation appended, which is why the baseline was green.

## Fix
Live-set GROWTH (a job started) bypasses the persist window — each start appends immediately, so the last snapshot always carries every started job and the invariant `lost == seeded live` holds. Settles keep riding the window: an unpersisted settle only overcounts `lost` on a crash (conservative — still never "running"). The gh-1590 diet stays in force for terminal churn; its wiring-test pin is revised to `<= starts + 1` with rationale.

## Gates
- `dart analyze` clean on touched files (lib/src/cli/agent_cli.dart, lib/src/cli/agent_hub_cli.dart, test/cli/shell_job_ledger_throttle_wiring_test.dart); `dart format` applied.
- `test/cli/shell_job_ledger_throttle_wiring_test.dart` 3/3 green, incl. a new crash-moment regression test (real AgentCli, frozen `ledgerClock`: at the SIGKILL-equivalent point the session file must already carry all 5 jobs as running). Verified the new test FAILS pre-fix (lib change stashed) and passes post-fix.
- `shell_job_ledger_caps_test.dart` + `subagent_registry_caps_test.dart` 18/18 green.
- The PTY repro itself needs a real pty (`openpty` is blocked in this dev sandbox) — CI nightly is its gate.

Closes #1622

AGENTS.md
# AGENTS.md

Conventions for AI agents and contributors in this repository. Keep it
factual: paths, commands, invariants — no essays.

## Project layout

- `lib/` — the `flutter_agent_harness` package (pure Dart core). `test/`
  mirrors it. `prompts/` — all LLM prompts as Markdown (see rules below).
- `lib/flutter_agent_harness.dart` (the barrel) — gh-1232 policy:
  GROUPED APPEND-ONLY export sections, one `// ── <subsystem> ──` comment
  header per group, exports sorted by path within a group, new exports
  appended to their subsystem group (a new subsystem starts a new group).
  No per-subsystem mini-barrels, no re-sorting of existing lines — append
  only, so parallel edits almost never touch the same line.
- God-file ceiling (gh-1232): no Dart file over 2800 lines anywhere
  (crap4dart `loc` gate, `max_lines: 2800` — issue #1234 migrated the
  shell guards; enforced whole-tree in CI and on staged files by the
  pre-commit hook. Scope: core `lib bin` via `crap4dart.yaml` +
  `test example` via the `crap4dart.loc-scope.yaml` companion config
  (0.11.0 has no per-gate sources override), flutter_app/lib via
  `flutter_app/crap4dart.yaml`).
  Target < 2000 for primary
  files; when a file approaches it, split by concern into `part` files
  (the established pattern: `agent_cli.dart`, `builtin_tools.dart`,
  `bin/fah.dart` → `bin/fah_*.dart`, `agent_service.dart` →
  `agent_service_*.dart` mixins) — never by extracting public API.
- `lib/src/approval/` — tool approval gate: tiers (read/write/exec),
  session modes (always-ask/write/yolo/autopilot — the CLI label of the
  `unattended` enum), per-tool overrides,
  critical-pattern
  `bash` interceptor, per-turn grants (`grantForTurn(allow:, deny:)` —
  skill `allowed-tools`/`disallowed-tools` manifest keys ride these for one
  turn; explicit deny > turnDeny > per-tool override > turnAllow >
  alwaysAllow > mode (critical bash outranks mode in always-ask/write/yolo,
  but is skipped in unattended so the mode never blocks — for runs with no
  user present); `clearTurnGrants()`
  on every new user
  message). Wired via `attachApproval` into `beforeToolCall` (runs
  first); prompt UI is an injectable `ApprovalPrompt` (null + prompt policy

Culprit: 872f3ccc47 (gh-1590/#1594 — session JSONL diet). Live-set GROWTH (a job started) bypasses the persist window — each start appends immediately, so the last snapshot always carries every started job and the invariant `lost == seeded live` holds. Settles keep riding the window: an unpersisted settle only overcounts `lost` on a crash (conservative — still never "running"). - **PR #**: 1623
- **URL**: https://github.com/IstiN/flutter_agent_harness/pull/1623
- **Title**: fix(1622): shell_job_registry persist window strands live jobs off the record on crash
- **Author**: vabhzw17eg2qu4m9-bit
- **Branch**: `fix/1622-job-board-restart-lost-count` → `main`
- **State**: open
- **Files Changed**: 3
- **Additions**: +117
- **Deletions**: -9
- **Created**: 2026-10-15T04:09:00Z
- **Updated**: 2026-10-15T04:18:06Z

## PR Description

## Problem
Nightly PTY red: `test/integration/job_board_stability_pty_test.dart:420` "restart with live jobs shows lost, never running" expects `5 background tasks lost`, got `✗ 1 background task lost on restart (process gone, no exit reported)` (run 38676570867, main 28927a1b0f). Green in the Oct-13/14 nightlies.

## Root cause
Culprit: 872f3ccc47 (gh-1590/#1594 — session JSONL diet). Its `LedgerSnapshotThrottle` (30 s `ledgerSnapshotPersistInterval`) rate-bounds `shell_job_registry` appends in `_persistJobBoard`: only the first board mutation in a window appends; the rest coalesce behind a trailing flush (real 30 s Timer) or the graceful shutdown flush. A SIGKILL runs neither. The PTY scenario launches 5 jobs inside one window then `hardKill`s — the file's last snapshot carries only job 1, so `_rehydrateJobBoard` demotes 1 live card to lost. Not a compaction/repair eviction: `repairKeepLatestCustomTypes` and the resume-time reader keep the LATEST snapshot; the records never reached the file. Pre-#1594 every mutation appended, which is why the baseline was green.

## Fix
Live-set GROWTH (a job started) bypasses the persist window — each start appends immediately, so the last snapshot always carries every started job and the invariant `lost == seeded live` holds. Settles keep riding the window: an unpersisted settle only overcounts `lost` on a crash (conservative — still never "running"). The gh-1590 diet stays in force for terminal churn; its wiring-test pin is revised to `<= starts + 1` with rationale.

## Gates
- `dart analyze` clean on touched files (lib/src/cli/agent_cli.dart, lib/src/cli/agent_hub_cli.dart, test/cli/shell_job_ledger_throttle_wiring_test.dart); `dart format` applied.
- `test/cli/shell_job_ledger_throttle_wiring_test.dart` 3/3 green, incl. a new crash-moment regression test (real AgentCli, frozen `ledgerClock`: at the SIGKILL-equivalent point the session file must already carry all 5 jobs as running). Verified the new test FAILS pre-fix (lib change stashed) and passes post-fix.
- `shell_job_ledger_caps_test.dart` + `subagent_registry_caps_test.dart` 18/18 green.
- The PTY repro itself needs a real pty (`openpty` is blocked in this dev sandbox) — CI nightly is its gate.

Closes #1622

# AGENTS.md

## Project layout

- `lib/` — the `flutter_agent_harness` package (pure Dart core). `test/`
  mirrors it. `prompts/` — all LLM prompts as Markdown (see rules below).

  GROUPED APPEND-ONLY export sections, one `// ── <subsystem> ──` comment
  header per group, exports sorted by path within a group, new exports
  appended to their subsystem group (a new subsystem starts a new group).
  No per-subsystem mini-barrels, no re-sorting of existing lines — append
  only, so parallel edits almost never touch the same line.
- God-file ceiling (gh-1232): no Dart file over 2800 lines anywhere

Nightly PTY red: `test/integration/job_board_stability_pty_test.dart:420` "restart with live jobs shows lost, never running" expects `5 background tasks lost`, got `✗ 1 background task lost on restart (process gone, no exit reported)` (run 38676570867, main 28927a1b0f). Green in the Oct-13/14 nightlies.

## Root cause
Culprit: 872f3ccc47 (gh-1590/#1594 — session JSONL diet). Its `LedgerSnapshotThrottle` (30 s `ledgerSnapshotPersistInterval`) rate-bounds `shell_job_registry` appends in `_persistJobBoard`: only the first board mutation in a window appends; the rest coalesce behind a trailing flush (real 30 s Timer) or the graceful shutdown flush. A SIGKILL runs neither. The PTY scenario launches 5 jobs inside one window then `hardKill`s — the file's last snapshot carries only job 1, so `_rehydrateJobBoard` demotes 1 live card to lost. Not a compaction/repair eviction: `repairKeepLatestCustomTypes` and the resume-time reader keep the LATEST snapshot; the records never reached the file. Pre-#1594 every mutation appended, which is why the baseline was green.

## Fix
Live-set GROWTH (a job started) bypasses the persist window — each start appends immediately, so the last snapshot always carries every started job and the invariant `lost == seeded live` holds. Settles keep riding the window: an unpersisted settle only overcounts `lost` on a crash (conservative — still never "running"). The gh-1590 diet stays in force for terminal churn; its wiring-test pin is revised to `<= starts + 1` with rationale.

- **Title**: fix(1622): shell_job_registry persist window strands live jobs off the record on crash
- **Author**: vabhzw17eg2qu4m9-bit
- **Branch**: `fix/1622-job-board-restart-lost-count` → `main`
- **State**: open
- **Files Changed**: 3
- **Additions**: +117
- **Deletions**: -9
- **Created**: 2026-10-15T04:09:00Z
- **Updated**: 2026-10-15T04:18:06Z

## PR Description

## Problem
Nightly PTY red: `test/integration/job_board_stability_pty_test.dart:420` "restart with live jobs shows lost, never running" expects `5 background tasks lost`, got `✗ 1 background task lost on restart (process gone, no exit reported)` (run 38676570867, main 28927a1b0f). Green in the Oct-13/14 nightlies.

## Root cause
Culprit: 872f3ccc47 (gh-1590/#1594 — session JSONL diet). Its `LedgerSnapshotThrottle` (30 s `ledgerSnapshotPersistInterval`) rate-bounds `shell_job_registry` appends in `_persistJobBoard`: only the first board mutation in a window appends; the rest coalesce behind a trailing flush (real 30 s Timer) or the graceful shutdown flush. A SIGKILL runs neither. The PTY scenario launches 5 jobs inside one window then `hardKill`s — the file's last snapshot carries only job 1, so `_rehydrateJobBoard` demotes 1 live card to lost. Not a compaction/repair eviction: `repairKeepLatestCustomTypes` and the resume-time reader keep the LATEST snapshot; the records never reached the file. Pre-#1594 every mutation appended, which is why the baseline was green.

## Fix
Live-set GROWTH (a job started) bypasses the persist window — each start appends immediately, so the last snapshot always carries every started job and the invariant `lost == seeded live` holds. Settles keep riding the window: an unpersisted settle only overcounts `lost` on a crash (conservative — still never "running"). The gh-1590 diet stays in force for terminal churn; its wiring-test pin is revised to `<= starts + 1` with rationale.

## Gates
- `dart analyze` clean on touched files (lib/src/cli/agent_cli.dart, lib/src/cli/agent_hub_cli.dart, test/cli/shell_job_ledger_throttle_wiring_test.dart); `dart format` applied.
- `test/cli/shell_job_ledger_throttle_wiring_test.dart` 3/3 green, incl. a new crash-moment regression test (real AgentCli, frozen `ledgerClock`: at the SIGKILL-equivalent point the session file must already carry all 5 jobs as running). Verified the new test FAILS pre-fix (lib change stashed) and passes post-fix.
- `shell_job_ledger_caps_test.dart` + `subagent_registry_caps_test.dart` 18/18 green.
- The PTY repro itself needs a real pty (`openpty` is blocked in this dev sandbox) — CI nightly is its gate.

Closes #1622

# AGENTS.md

Conventions for AI agents and contributors in this repository. Keep it
factual: paths, commands, invariants — no essays.

## Project layout

- `lib/` — the `flutter_agent_harness` package (pure Dart core). `test/`
  mirrors it. `prompts/` — all LLM prompts as Markdown (see rules below).
- `lib/flutter_agent_harness.dart` (the barrel) — gh-1232 policy:
  GROUPED APPEND-ONLY export sections, one `// ── <subsystem> ──` comment
  header per group, exports sorted by path within a group, new exports
  appended to their subsystem group (a new subsystem starts a new group).
  No per-subsystem mini-barrels, no re-sorting of existing lines — append
  only, so parallel edits almost never touch the same line.
- God-file ceiling (gh-1232): no Dart file over 2800 lines anywhere

  "fields": {
    "summary": "fix(1622): shell_job_registry persist window strands live jobs off the record on crash",
    "description": "## Problem
Nightly PTY red: `test/integration/job_board_stability_pty_test.dart:420` "restart with live jobs shows lost, never running" expects `5 background tasks lost`, got `✗ 1 background task lost on restart (process gone, no exit reported)` (run 38676570867, main 28927a1b0f). Green in the Oct-13/14 nightlies.

## Root cause
Culprit: 872f3ccc47 (gh-1590/#1594 — session JSONL diet). Its `LedgerSnapshotThrottle` (30 s `ledgerSnapshotPersistInterval`) rate-bounds `shell_job_registry` appends in `_persistJobBoard`: only the first board mutation in a window appends; the rest coalesce behind a trailing flush (real 30 s Timer) or the graceful shutdown flush. A SIGKILL runs neither. The PTY scenario launches 5 jobs inside one window then `hardKill`s — the file's last snapshot carries only job 1, so `_rehydrateJobBoard` demotes 1 live card to lost. Not a compaction/repair eviction: `repairKeepLatestCustomTypes` and the resume-time reader keep the LATEST snapshot; the records never reached the file. Pre-#1594 every mutation appended, which is why the baseline was green.

## Fix
Live-set GROWTH (a job started) bypasses the persist window — each start appends immediately, so the last snapshot always carries every started job and the invariant `lost == seeded live` holds. Settles keep riding the window: an unpersisted settle only overcounts `lost` on a crash (conservative — still never "running"). The gh-1590 diet stays in force for terminal churn; its wiring-test pin is revised to `<= starts + 1` with rationale.

## Gates
- `dart analyze` clean on touched files (lib/src/cli/agent_cli.dart, lib/src/cli/agent_hub_cli.dart, test/cli/shell_job_ledger_throttle_wiring_test.dart); `dart format` applied.

Verified the new test FAILS pre-fix (lib change stashed) and passes post-fix.
- `shell_job_ledger_caps_test.dart` + `subagent_registry_caps_test.dart` 18/18 green.
- The PTY repro itself needs a real pty (`openpty` is blocked in this dev sandbox) — CI nightly is its gate.

Closes #1622"

- **Title**: fix(1622): shell_job_registry persist window strands live jobs off the record on crash
- **Author**: vabhzw17eg2qu4m9-bit
- **Branch**: `fix/1622-job-board-restart-lost-count` → `main`
- **State**: open
- **Files Changed**: 3
- **Additions**: +117
- **Deletions**: -9
- **Created**: 2026-10-15T04:09:00Z
- **Updated**: 2026-10-15T04:18:06Z

## PR Description

## Problem
Nightly PTY red: `test/integration/job_board_stability_pty_test.dart:420` "restart with live jobs shows lost, never running" expects `5 background tasks lost`, got `✗ 1 background task lost on restart (process gone, no exit reported)` (run 38676570867, main 28927a1b0f). Green in the Oct-13/14 nightlies.

## Root cause
Culprit: 872f3ccc47 (gh-1590/#1594 — session JSONL diet). Its `LedgerSnapshotThrottle` (30 s `ledgerSnapshotPersistInterval`) rate-bounds `shell_job_registry` appends in `_persistJobBoard`: only the first board mutation in a window appends; the rest coalesce behind a trailing flush (real 30 s Timer) or the graceful shutdown flush. A SIGKILL runs neither. The PTY scenario launches 5 jobs inside one window then `hardKill`s — the file's last snapshot carries only job 1, so `_rehydrateJobBoard` demotes 1 live card to lost. Not a compaction/repair eviction: `repairKeepLatestCustomTypes` and the resume-time reader keep the LATEST snapshot; the records never reached the file. Pre-#1594 every mutation appended, which is why the baseline was green.

## Fix
Live-set GROWTH (a job started) bypasses the persist window — each start appends immediately, so the last snapshot always carries every started job and the invariant `lost == seeded live` holds. Settles keep riding the window: an unpersisted settle only overcounts `lost` on a crash (conservative — still never "running"). The gh-1590 diet stays in force for terminal churn; its wiring-test pin is revised to `<= starts + 1` with rationale.

## Gates
- `dart analyze` clean on touched files (lib/src/cli/agent_cli.dart, lib/src/cli/agent_hub_cli.dart, test/cli/shell_job_ledger_throttle_wiring_test.dart); `dart format` applied.
- `test/cli/shell_job_ledger_throttle_wiring_test.dart` 3/3 green, incl. a new crash-moment regression test (real AgentCli, frozen `ledgerClock`: at the SIGKILL-equivalent point the session file must already carry all 5 jobs as running). Verified the new test FAILS pre-fix (lib change stashed) and passes post-fix.
- `shell_job_ledger_caps_test.dart` + `subagent_registry_caps_test.dart` 18/18 green.
- The PTY repro itself needs a real pty (`openpty` is blocked in this dev sandbox) — CI nightly is its gate.

Closes #1622

AGENTS.md
# AGENTS.md

Conventions for AI agents and contributors in this repository. Keep it
factual: paths, commands, invariants — no essays.

## Project layout

- `lib/` — the `flutter_agent_harness` package (pure Dart core). `test/`
  mirrors it. `prompts/` — all LLM prompts as Markdown (see rules below).
- `lib/flutter_agent_harness.dart` (the barrel) — gh-1232 policy:
  GROUPED APPEND-ONLY export sections, one `// ── <subsystem> ──` comment
  header per group, exports sorted by path within a group, new exports
  appended to their subsystem group (a new subsystem starts a new group).
  No per-subsystem mini-barrels, no re-sorting of existing lines — append
  only, so parallel edits almost never touch the same line.
- God-file ceiling (gh-1232): no Dart file over 2800 lines anywhere
  (crap4dart `loc` gate, `max_lines: 2800` — issue #1234 migrated the
  shell guards; enforced whole-tree in CI and on staged files by the
  pre-commit hook. Scope: core `lib bin` via `crap4dart.yaml` +
  `test example` via the `crap4dart.loc-scope.yaml` companion config
  (0.11.0 has no per-gate sources override), flutter_app/lib via
  `flutter_app/crap4dart.yaml`).
  Target < 2000 for primary
  files; when a file approaches it, split by concern into `part` files
  (the established pattern: `agent_cli.dart`, `builtin_tools.dart`,
  `bin/fah.dart` → `bin/fah_*.dart`, `agent_service.dart` →
  `agent_service_*.dart` mixins) — never by extracting public API.
- `lib/src/approval/` — tool approval gate: tiers (read/write/exec),
  session modes (always-ask/write/yolo/autopilot — the CLI label of the
  `unattended` enum), per-tool overrides,
  critical-pattern
  `bash` interceptor, per-turn grants (`grantForTurn(allow:, deny:)` —
  skill `allowed-tools`/`disallowed-tools` manifest keys ride these for one
  turn; explicit deny > turnDeny > per-tool override > turnAllow >
  alwaysAllow > mode (critical bash outranks mode in always-ask/write/yolo,
  but is skipped in unattended so the mode never blocks — for runs with no
  user present); `clearTurnGrants()`
  on every new user

  first); prompt UI is an injectable `ApprovalPrompt` (null + prompt policy
  = deny).
- `lib/src/tools/ask_tool.dart` — `ask` tool: structured mid-turn questions

    "description": "## Problem
Nightly PTY red: `test/integration/job_board_stability_pty_test.dart:420` "restart with live jobs shows lost, never running" expects `5 background tasks lost`, got `✗ 1 background task lost on restart (process gone, no exit reported)` (run 38676570867, main 28927a1b0f). Green in the Oct-13/14 nightlies.

## Root cause
Culprit: 872f3ccc47 (gh-1590/#1594 — session JSONL diet). Its `LedgerSnapshotThrottle` (30 s `ledgerSnapshotPersistInterval`) rate-bounds `shell_job_registry` appends in `_persistJobBoard`: only the first board mutation in a window appends; the rest coalesce behind a trailing flush (real 30 s Timer) or the graceful shutdown flush. A SIGKILL runs neither. The PTY scenario launches 5 jobs inside one window then `hardKill`s — the file's last snapshot carries only job 1, so `_rehydrateJobBoard` demotes 1 live card to lost. Not a compaction/repair eviction: `repairKeepLatestCustomTypes` and the resume-time reader keep the LATEST snapshot; the records never reached the file. Pre-#1594 every mutation appended, which is why the baseline was green.

## Fix
Live-set GROWTH (a job started) bypasses the persist window — each start appends immediately, so the last snapshot always carries every started job and the invariant `lost == seeded live` holds. Settles keep riding the window: an unpersisted settle only overcounts `lost` on a crash (conservative — still never "running"). The gh-1590 diet stays in force for terminal churn; its wiring-test pin is revised to `<= starts + 1` with rationale.

- The PTY repro itself needs a real pty (`openpty` is blocked in this dev sandbox) — CI nightly is its gate.

# Pull Request Information

- **PR #**: 1623
- **URL**: https://github.com/IstiN/flutter_agent_harness/pull/1623
- **Title**: fix(1622): shell_job_registry persist window strands live jobs off the record on crash
- **Author**: vabhzw17eg2qu4m9-bit
- **Branch**: `fix/1622-job-board-restart-lost-count` → `main`
- **State**: open
- **Files Changed**: 3
- **Additions**: +117
- **Deletions**: -9
- **Created**: 2026-10-15T04:09:00Z
- **Updated**: 2026-10-15T04:18:06Z

## PR Description

## Problem
Nightly PTY red: `test/integration/job_board_stability_pty_test.dart:420` "restart with live jobs shows lost, never running" expects `5 background tasks lost`, got `✗ 1 background task lost on restart (process gone, no exit reported)` (run 38676570867, main 28927a1b0f). Green in the Oct-13/14 nightlies.

## Root cause
Culprit: 872f3ccc47 (gh-1590/#1594 — session JSONL diet). Its `LedgerSnapshotThrottle` (30 s `ledgerSnapshotPersistInterval`) rate-bounds `shell_job_registry` appends in `_persistJobBoard`: only the first board mutation in a window appends; the rest coalesce behind a trailing flush (real 30 s Timer) or the graceful shutdown flush. A SIGKILL runs neither. The PTY scenario launches 5 jobs inside one window then `hardKill`s — the file's last snapshot carries only job 1, so `_rehydrateJobBoard` demotes 1 live card to lost. Not a compaction/repair eviction: `repairKeepLatestCustomTypes` and the resume-time reader keep the LATEST snapshot; the records never reached the file. Pre-#1594 every mutation appended, which is why the baseline was green.

## Fix
Live-set GROWTH (a job started) bypasses the persist window — each start appends immediately, so the last snapshot always carries every started job and the invariant `lost == seeded live` holds. Settles keep riding the window: an unpersisted settle only overcounts `lost` on a crash (conservative — still never "running"). The gh-1590 diet stays in force for terminal churn; its wiring-test pin is revised to `<= starts + 1` with rationale.

## Gates
- `dart analyze` clean on touched files (lib/src/cli/agent_cli.dart, lib/src/cli/agent_hub_cli.dart, test/cli/shell_job_ledger_throttle_wiring_test.dart); `dart format` applied.
- `test/cli/shell_job_ledger_throttle_wiring_test.dart` 3/3 green, incl. a new crash-moment regression test (real AgentCli, frozen `ledgerClock`: at the SIGKILL-equivalent point the session file must already carry all 5 jobs as running). Verified the new test FAILS pre-fix (lib change stashed) and passes post-fix.
- `shell_job_ledger_caps_test.dart` + `subagent_registry_caps_test.dart` 18/18 green.
- The PTY repro itself needs a real pty (`openpty` is blocked in this dev sandbox) — CI nightly is its gate.

Closes #1622

AGENTS.md
# AGENTS.md

Conventions for AI agents and contributors in this repository. Keep it
factual: paths, commands, invariants — no essays.

## Project layout

- `lib/` — the `flutter_agent_harness` package (pure Dart core). `test/`
  mirrors it. `prompts/` — all LLM prompts as Markdown (see rules below).
- `lib/flutter_agent_harness.dart` (the barrel) — gh-1232 policy:
  GROUPED APPEND-ONLY export sections, one `// ── <subsystem> ──` comment
  header per group, exports sorted by path within a group, new exports
  appended to their subsystem group (a new subsystem starts a new group).
  No per-subsystem mini-barrels, no re-sorting of existing lines — append
  only, so parallel edits almost never touch the same line.
- God-file ceiling (gh-1232): no Dart file over 2800 lines anywhere
  (crap4dart `loc` gate, `max_lines: 2800` — issue #1234 migrated the
  shell guards; enforced whole-tree in CI and on staged files by the
  pre-commit hook. Scope: core `lib bin` via `crap4dart.yaml` +
  `test example` via the `crap4dart.loc-scope.yaml` companion config
  (0.11.0 has no per-gate sources override), flutter_app/lib via
  `flutter_app/crap4dart.yaml`).
  Target < 2000 for primary
  files; when a file approaches it, split by concern into `part` files
  (the established pattern: `agent_cli.dart`, `builtin_tools.dart`,
  `bin/fah.dart` → `bin/fah_*.dart`, `agent_service.dart` →
  `agent_service_*.dart` mixins) — never by extracting public API.
- `lib/src/approval/` — tool approval gate: tiers (read/write/exec),
  session modes (always-ask/write/yolo/autopilot — the CLI label of the
  `unattended` enum), per-tool overrides,
  critical-pattern
  `bash` interceptor, per-turn grants (`grantForTurn(allow:, deny:)` —
  skill `allowed-tools`/`disallowed-tools` manifest keys ride these for one
  turn; explicit deny > turnDeny > per-tool override > turnAllow >
  alwaysAllow > mode (critical bash outranks mode in always-ask/write/yolo,
  but is skipped in unattended so the mode never blocks — for runs with no
  user present); `clearTurnGrants()`
  on every new user
  message). Wired via `attachApproval` into `beforeToolCall` (runs
  first); prompt UI is an injectable `ApprovalPrompt` (null + prompt policy
  = deny).
- `lib/src/tools/ask_tool.dart` — `ask` tool: structured mid-turn questions
  via injectable `AskCallback` (null = error, cancel = plain result).
- `lib/src/tools/request_secret_tool.dart` — `request_secret` tool: the agent
  asks the USER for a missing credential via injectable
  `RequestSecretCallback` (never in chat text); a grant returns
  `RequestSecretResult` (host-adjusted `name`, `value`, `persisted` flag),
  a decline is a plain result. The app wires it in `AgentService` to
  `secretRequestHandler` (chat screen installs
  `ui/widgets/secret_request_sheet.dart`): a grant is persisted into

**Scenario analysis:**

`_persistJobBoard` chain body:
1. records = board.toRecords(); if empty return.
2. liveIds = set of ids where state == running.
3. grewLive = persistedIds != null && liveIds.any(not in persistedIds).
4. Gate: if (!force && !grewLive && !throttle.shouldPersistNow()) return;
5. json = encode(records); if (!deduper.shouldPersist(json)) return;
6. append → confirm deduper, throttle.confirmPersisted(), persistedLiveIds = liveIds.

**Critical bug candidate #1 — the bypass path skips `shouldPersistNow()`, so a refused/pending window stays pending forever?**

Flow: mutation A (a settle) refused → `_pendingSince` set, timer armed (30s trailing flush). Then mutation B (a start) → grewLive → bypass window → appends → `confirmPersisted()` → `_pendingSince = null`, timer cancelled. Fine — the flush was consumed by the append.

**Critical bug candidate #2 — grewLive path with a not-yet-persisted baseline:**

`_jobBoardPersistedLiveIds == null` until the FIRST append. Consider a crash-critical sequence where the first board mutation is REFUSED by the window (possible only if `shouldPersistNow()` returns false, which happens when `_lastPersistAt != null` — i.e., after a previous append — or reset not called). When is persistedLiveIds null but `_lastPersistAt != null`?

- After `_rehydrateJobBoard`: throttle.reset() → `_lastPersistAt = null`. So first shouldPersistNow → true → append. persistedLiveIds set. OK.
- Session switch where `latest.isEmpty` → early return: throttle.reset() called, deduper/liveIds NOT reset... wait, actually the throttle IS reset before the empty check. And persistedLiveIds stays stale-non-null with a stale throttle (reset). Then first mutation: grewLive check against stale ids → new job not in stale set → grewLive=true → append. Or if no growth → shouldPersistNow → true (reset) → append. So in practice after any rehydrate the first append happens. persistedLiveIds null + refused window seems unreachable... except one case: `force` flush... no, force appends.

Hmm — what about the case where the append THROWS in step 6? deduper reverted, persistedLiveIds not updated, throttle NOT confirmed. Mutation retry (same settle, no growth): window still refused (lastPersistAt from previous append), grewLive=false → refused again. Eventually trailing flush at 30s retries. That's the pre-existing design (coalescing). For starts: grewLive=true → retry immediately. Fine.

{
  "key": "pr-1623",
  "fields": {
    "summary": "fix(1622): shell_job_registry persist window strands live jobs off the record on crash",
    "description": "## Problem
Nightly PTY red: `test/integration/job_board_stability_pty_test.dart:420` "restart with live jobs shows lost, never running" expects `5 background tasks lost`, got `✗ 1 background task lost on restart (process gone, no exit reported)` (run 38676570867, main 28927a1b0f). Green in the Oct-13/14 nightlies.

## Root cause
Culprit: 872f3ccc47 (gh-1590/#1594 — session JSONL diet). Its `LedgerSnapshotThrottle` (30 s `ledgerSnapshotPersistInterval`) rate-bounds `shell_job_registry` appends in `_persistJobBoard`: only the first board mutation in a window appends; the rest coalesce behind a trailing flush (real 30 s Timer) or the graceful shutdown flush. A SIGKILL runs neither. The PTY scenario launches 5 jobs inside one window then `hardKill`s — the file's last snapshot carries only job 1, so `_rehydrateJobBoard` demotes 1 live card to lost. Not a compaction/repair eviction: `repairKeepLatestCustomTypes` and the resume-time reader keep the LATEST snapshot; the records never reached the file. Pre-#1594 every mutation appended, which is why the baseline was green.

## Fix
Live-set GROWTH (a job started) bypasses the persist window — each start appends immediately, so the last snapshot always carries every started job and the invariant `lost == seeded live` holds. Settles keep riding the window: an unpersisted settle only overcounts `lost` on a crash (conservative — still never "running"). The gh-1590 diet stays in force for terminal churn; its wiring-test pin is revised to `<= starts + 1` with rationale.

# Pull Request Information

- **PR #**: 1623
- **URL**: https://github.com/IstiN/flutter_agent_harness/pull/1623
- **Title**: fix(1622): shell_job_registry persist window strands live jobs off the record on crash
- **Author**: vabhzw17eg2qu4m9-bit
- **Branch**: `fix/1622-job-board-restart-lost-count` → `main`
- **State**: open
- **Files Changed**: 3
- **Additions**: +117
- **Deletions**: -9
- **Created**: 2026-10-15T04:09:00Z
- **Updated**: 2026-10-15T04:18:06Z

## PR Description

## Problem
Nightly PTY red: `test/integration/job_board_stability_pty_test.dart:420` "restart with live jobs shows lost, never running" expects `5 background tasks lost`, got `✗ 1 background task lost on restart (process gone, no exit reported)` (run 38676570867, main 28927a1b0f). Green in the Oct-13/14 nightlies.

## Root cause
Culprit: 872f3ccc47 (gh-1590/#1594 — session JSONL diet). Its `LedgerSnapshotThrottle` (30 s `ledgerSnapshotPersistInterval`) rate-bounds `shell_job_registry` appends in `_persistJobBoard`: only the first board mutation in a window appends; the rest coalesce behind a trailing flush (real 30 s Timer) or the graceful shutdown flush. A SIGKILL runs neither. The PTY scenario launches 5 jobs inside one window then `hardKill`s — the file's last snapshot carries only job 1, so `_rehydrateJobBoard` demotes 1 live card to lost. Not a compaction/repair eviction: `repairKeepLatestCustomTypes` and the resume-time reader keep the LATEST snapshot; the records never reached the file. Pre-#1594 every mutation appended, which is why the baseline was green.

## Fix
Live-set GROWTH (a job started) bypasses the persist window — each start appends immediately, so the last snapshot always carries every started job and the invariant `lost == seeded live` holds. Settles keep riding the window: an unpersisted settle only overcounts `lost` on a crash (conservative — still never "running"). The gh-1590 diet stays in force for terminal churn; its wiring-test pin is revised to `<= starts + 1` with rationale.

## Gates
- `dart analyze` clean on touched files (lib/src/cli/agent_cli.dart, lib/src/cli/agent_hub_cli.dart, test/cli/shell_job_ledger_throttle_wiring_test.dart); `dart format` applied.
- `test/cli/shell_job_ledger_throttle_wiring_test.dart` 3/3 green, incl. a new crash-moment regression test (real AgentCli, frozen `ledgerClock`: at the SIGKILL-equivalent point the session file must already carry all 5 jobs as running). Verified the new test FAILS pre-fix (lib change stashed) and passes post-fix.
- `shell_job_ledger_caps_test.dart` + `subagent_registry_caps_test.dart` 18/18 green.
- The PTY repro itself needs a real pty (`openpty` is blocked in this dev sandbox) — CI nightly is its gate.

Closes #1622

# AGENTS.md

Conventions for AI agents and contributors in this repository. Keep it
factual: paths, commands, invariants — no essays.

## Project layout

- `lib/` — the `flutter_agent_harness` package (pure Dart core). `test/`
  mirrors it. `prompts/` — all LLM prompts as Markdown (see rules below).
- `lib/flutter_agent_harness.dart` (the barrel) — gh-1232 policy:
  GROUPED APPEND-ONLY export sections, one `// ── <subsystem> ──` comment
  header per group, exports sorted by path within a group, new exports
  appended to their subsystem group (a new subsystem starts a new group).
  No per-subsystem mini-barrels, no re-sorting of existing lines — append
  only, so parallel edits almost never touch the same line.
- God-file ceiling (gh-1232): no Dart file over 2800 lines anywhere
  (crap4dart `loc` gate, `max_lines: 2800` — issue #1234 migrated the
  shell guards; enforced whole-tree in CI and on staged files by the
  pre-commit hook. Scope: core `lib bin` via `crap4dart.yaml` +
  `test example` via the `crap4dart.loc-scope.yaml` companion config
  (0.11.0 has no per-gate sources override), flutter_app/lib via
  `flutter_app/crap4dart.yaml`).
  Target < 2000 for primary
  files; when a file approaches it, split by concern into `part` files
  (the established pattern: `agent_cli.dart`, `builtin_tools.dart`,
  `bin/fah.dart` → `bin/fah_*.dart`, `agent_service.dart` →
  `agent_service_*.dart` mixins) — never by extracting public API.
- `lib/src/approval/` — tool approval gate: tiers (read/write/exec),
  session modes (always-ask/write/yolo/autopilot — the CLI label of the
  `unattended` enum), per-tool overrides,
  critical-pattern

  skill `allowed-tools`/`disallowed-tools` manifest keys ride these for one

Now I understand the throttle/deduper. Let me analyze the grewLive logic more carefully.

**Scenario analysis:**

`_persistJobBoard` chain body:
1. records = board.toRecords(); if empty return.
2. liveIds = set of ids where state == running.
3. grewLive = persistedIds != null && liveIds.any(not in persistedIds).
4. Gate: if (!force && !grewLive && !throttle.shouldPersistNow()) return;
5. json = encode(records); if (!deduper.shouldPersist(json)) return;
6. append → confirm deduper, throttle.confirmPersisted(), persistedLiveIds = liveIds.

**Critical bug candidate #1 — the bypass path skips `shouldPersistNow()`, so a refused/pending window stays pending forever?**

Flow: mutation A (a settle) refused → `_pendingSince` set, timer armed (30s trailing flush). Then mutation B (a start) → grewLive → bypass window → appends → `confirmPersisted()` → `_pendingSince = null`, timer cancelled. Fine — the flush was consumed by the append.

**Critical bug candidate #2 — grewLive path with a not-yet-persisted baseline:**

`_jobBoardPersistedLiveIds == null` until the FIRST append. Consider a crash-critical sequence where the first board mutation is REFUSED by the window (possible only if `shouldPersistNow()` returns false, which happens when `_lastPersistAt != null` — i.e., after a previous append — or reset not called). When is persistedLiveIds null but `_lastPersistAt != null`?

- After `_rehydrateJobBoard`: throttle.reset() → `_lastPersistAt = null`. So first shouldPersistNow → true → append. persistedLiveIds set. OK.
- Session switch where `latest.isEmpty` → early return: throttle.reset() called, deduper/liveIds NOT reset... wait, actually the throttle IS reset before the empty check. And persistedLiveIds stays stale-non-null with a stale throttle (reset). Then first mutation: grewLive check against stale ids → new job not in stale set → grewLive=true → append. Or if no growth → shouldPersistNow → true (reset) → append. So in practice after any rehydrate the first append happens. persistedLiveIds null + refused window seems unreachable... except one case: `force` flush... no, force appends.

Hmm — what about the case where the append THROWS in step 6? deduper reverted, persistedLiveIds not updated, throttle NOT confirmed. Mutation retry (same settle, no growth): window still refused (lastPersistAt from previous append), grewLive=false → refused again. Eventually trailing flush at 30s retries. That's the pre-existing design (coalescing). For starts: grewLive=true → retry immediately. Fine.

**Critical bug candidate #3 — `records` cap and the live set.**

`toRecords()` — "the capped card count" (shell_job_board.dart:317 "The shell_job_registry records (issue #429 AC9): the capped card..."). Let me read shell_job_board.dart toRecords and latestRecords — there's `maxPersistedCards` cap at line 56. If the board holds MORE running jobs than the cap, the persisted snapshot keeps only the latest N cards → resume lost count limited by cap — pre-existing behavior (issue #429 AC9), not this PR's concern.

But there IS an interaction worth checking: `liveIds` is derived from `records` (capped), not from the full board. If the cap drops older running jobs, grewLive detects growth only among capped records — a growth below the cap window still detected. Edge enough, pre-existing cap. Not blocking.

**Critical bug candidate #4 — resume with running cards → state after rehydration.**

After resume, `_jobBoard = ShellJobBoard.rehydrated(latest)`. What state do the rehydrated live cards carry? "Jobs that were live at restart print their lost card" — presumably rehydrated marks them lost (never show running, issue #429). So records after rehydration have state=lost for those, and liveIds=∅ → `_jobBoardPersistedLiveIds = ∅` on the first append. A new job starts → grewLive (new id not in ∅) → bypass → append. 

**Critical bug candidate #5 — the gate refuses a grewLive=false mutation, but the persisted snapshot ALREADY includes this settle (dedupe)?** No — refusal returns before serialize; harmless.

So exactly k+1... but actually there's a subtlety: start #1 appends, starts 2..k append (bypass), settles refused (coalesce), finalize flush appends → k+1 total. Pin `<= jobCount + 1` — correct. But is the diet still effective for the ORIGINAL gh-1590 scenario (2k mutations, k starts + k settles)? Records = k+1 instead of 2 — that's the documented tradeoff ("pin revised to <= starts + 1 with rationale"). Hmm — is that acceptable for the gh-1590 diet goal? The diet's purpose: bound session growth. k+1 is still linear in k, not constant. The original gh-1590 ticket's session had 1,635 snapshots for a board with churn — starts+1 is still bounded by starts, which is bounded by the number of jobs. Starts are comparatively rare vs state changes? Actually each job start IS a state change (pending→running), and settles (running→done) coalesce. So worst case halves... no wait, pre-#1590 every mutation appended: 2k records; post: k+1. The diet remains for terminal churn. Acceptable and documented. But note: repeated RESTARTS of jobs (start/stop churn) — each start appends. A churn-heavy workload (start/kill loop) still grows linearly with starts. That's the deliberate design decision, documented in the PR. Not blocking; could note as a consideration but it's the entire point of the fix.

**Candidate #8 — THE REAL EDGE: growth detected but payload refused by DEDUPER?** Covered — growth changes bytes. But WAIT: what if two chain bodies run for the same snapshot? E.g., a start mutation enqueues persist (chain body 1) and the settle flush... chain serializes; body 2 recomputes records; deduper suppresses identical. Fine.

**Candidate #10 — a settle that removes the last running job makes liveIds empty; then `_jobBoardPersistedLiveIds = ∅`; a NEW start bypasses → good.

The last snapshot already carries job-1 as running. So resume sees it lost — correct-ish. What if the coalesced window contains BOTH the settle AND the re-start?     "summary": "fix(1622): shell_job_registry persist window strands live jobs off the record on crash",
    "description": "## Problem
Nightly PTY red: `test/integration/job_board_stability_pty_test.dart:420` "restart with live jobs shows lost, never running" expects `5 background tasks lost`, got `✗ 1 background task lost on restart (process gone, no exit reported)` (run 38676570867, main 28927a1b0f). Green in the Oct-13/14 nightlies.

## Root cause
Culprit: 872f3ccc47 (gh-1590/#1594 — session JSONL diet). Its `LedgerSnapshotThrottle` (30 s `ledgerSnapshotPersistInterval`) rate-bounds `shell_job_registry` appends in `_persistJobBoard`: only the first board mutation in a window appends; the rest coalesce behind a trailing flush (real 30 s Timer) or the graceful shutdown flush. A SIGKILL runs neither. The PTY scenario launches 5 jobs inside one window then `hardKill`s — the file's last snapshot carries only job 1, so `_rehydrateJobBoard` demotes 1 live card to lost. Not a compaction/repair eviction: `repairKeepLatestCustomTypes` and the resume-time reader keep the LATEST snapshot; the records never reached the file. Pre-#1594 every mutation appended, which is why the baseline was green.

## Fix
Live-set GROWTH (a job started) bypasses the persist window — each start appends immediately, so the last snapshot always carries every started job and the invariant `lost == seeded live` holds. Settles keep riding the window: an unpersisted settle only overcounts `lost` on a crash (conservative — still never "running"). The gh-1590 diet stays in force for terminal churn; its wiring-test pin is revised to `<= starts + 1` with rationale.

- **Title**: fix(1622): shell_job_registry persist window strands live jobs off the record on crash
- **Author**: vabhzw17eg2qu4m9-bit
- **Branch**: `fix/1622-job-board-restart-lost-count` → `main`
- **State**: open
- **Files Changed**: 3
- **Additions**: +117
- **Deletions**: -9
- **Created**: 2026-10-15T04:09:00Z
- **Updated**: 2026-10-15T04:18:06Z

## PR Description

## Problem
Nightly PTY red: `test/integration/job_board_stability_pty_test.dart:420` "restart with live jobs shows lost, never running" expects `5 background tasks lost`, got `✗ 1 background task lost on restart (process gone, no exit reported)` (run 38676570867, main 28927a1b0f). Green in the Oct-13/14 nightlies.

## Root cause
Culprit: 872f3ccc47 (gh-1590/#1594 — session JSONL diet). Its `LedgerSnapshotThrottle` (30 s `ledgerSnapshotPersistInterval`) rate-bounds `shell_job_registry` appends in `_persistJobBoard`: only the first board mutation in a window appends; the rest coalesce behind a trailing flush (real 30 s Timer) or the graceful shutdown flush. A SIGKILL runs neither. The PTY scenario launches 5 jobs inside one window then `hardKill`s — the file's last snapshot carries only job 1, so `_rehydrateJobBoard` demotes 1 live card to lost. Not a compaction/repair eviction: `repairKeepLatestCustomTypes` and the resume-time reader keep the LATEST snapshot; the records never reached the file. Pre-#1594 every mutation appended, which is why the baseline was green.

## Fix
Live-set GROWTH (a job started) bypasses the persist window — each start appends immediately, so the last snapshot always carries every started job and the invariant `lost == seeded live` holds. Settles keep riding the window: an unpersisted settle only overcounts `lost` on a crash (conservative — still never "running"). The gh-1590 diet stays in force for terminal churn; its wiring-test pin is revised to `<= starts + 1` with rationale.

## Gates
- `dart analyze` clean on touched files (lib/src/cli/agent_cli.dart, lib/src/cli/agent_hub_cli.dart, test/cli/shell_job_ledger_throttle_wiring_test.dart); `dart format` applied.
- `test/cli/shell_job_ledger_throttle_wiring_test.dart` 3/3 green, incl. a new crash-moment regression test (real AgentCli, frozen `ledgerClock`: at the SIGKILL-equivalent point the session file must already carry all 5 jobs as running). Verified the new test FAILS pre-fix (lib change stashed) and passes post-fix.
- `shell_job_ledger_caps_test.dart` + `subagent_registry_caps_test.dart` 18/18 green.
- The PTY repro itself needs a real pty (`openpty` is blocked in this dev sandbox) — CI nightly is its gate.

Closes #1622

# AGENTS.md

Conventions for AI agents and contributors in this repository. Keep it
factual: paths, commands, invariants — no essays.

## Project layout

- `lib/` — the `flutter_agent_harness` package (pure Dart core). `test/`
  mirrors it. `prompts/` — all LLM prompts as Markdown (see rules below).
- `lib/flutter_agent_harness.dart` (the barrel) — gh-1232 policy:
  GROUPED APPEND-ONLY export sections, one `// ── <subsystem> ──` comment
  header per group, exports sorted by path within a group, new exports
  appended to their subsystem group (a new subsystem starts a new group).
  No per-subsystem mini-barrels, no re-sorting of existing lines — append
  only, so parallel edits almost never touch the same line.
- God-file ceiling (gh-1232): no Dart file over 2800 lines anywhere
  (crap4dart `loc` gate, `max_lines: 2800` — issue #1234 migrated the
  shell guards; enforced whole-tree in CI and on staged files by the
  pre-commit hook. Scope: core `lib bin` via `crap4dart.yaml` +
  `test example` via the `crap4dart.loc-scope.yaml` companion config
  (0.11.0 has no per-gate sources override), flutter_app/lib via
  `flutter_app/crap4dart.yaml`).
  Target < 2000 for primary
  files; when a file approaches it, split by concern into `part` files

`_persistJobBoard` chain body:

5. json = encode(records); if (!deduper.shouldPersist(json)) return;
6. append → confirm deduper, throttle.confirmPersisted(), persistedLiveIds = liveIds.

**Critical bug candidate #1 — the bypass path skips `shouldPersistNow()`, so a refused/pending window stays pending forever?**

Flow: mutation A (a settle) refused → `_pendingSince` set, timer armed (30s trailing flush). Then mutation B (a start) → grewLive → bypass window → appends → `confirmPersisted()` → `_pendingSince = null`, timer cancelled. Fine — the flush was consumed by the append.

**Critical bug candidate #2 — grewLive path with a not-yet-persisted baseline:**

`_jobBoardPersistedLiveIds == null` until the FIRST append. Consider a crash-critical sequence where the first board mutation is REFUSED by the window (possible only if `shouldPersistNow()` returns false, which happens when `_lastPersistAt != null` — i.e., after a previous append — or reset not called). When is persistedLiveIds null but `_lastPersistAt != null`?

And persistedLiveIds stays stale-non-null with a stale throttle (reset). Then first mutation: grewLive check against stale ids → new job not in stale set → grewLive=true → append. Or if no growth → shouldPersistNow → true (reset) → append. So in practice after any rehydrate the first append happens. persistedLiveIds null + refused window seems unreachable... except one case: `force` flush... no, force appends.

Hmm — what about the case where the append THROWS in step 6? deduper reverted, persistedLiveIds not updated, throttle NOT confirmed. Mutation retry (same settle, no growth): window still refused (lastPersistAt from previous append), grewLive=false → refused again. Eventually trailing flush at 30s retries.     "description": "## Problem
Nightly PTY red: `test/integration/job_board_stability_pty_test.dart:420` "restart with live jobs shows lost, never running" expects `5 background tasks lost`, got `✗ 1 background task lost on restart (process gone, no exit reported)` (run 38676570867, main 28927a1b0f). Green in the Oct-13/14 nightlies.

## Root cause
Culprit: 872f3ccc47 (gh-1590/#1594 — session JSONL diet). Its `LedgerSnapshotThrottle` (30 s `ledgerSnapshotPersistInterval`) rate-bounds `shell_job_registry` appends in `_persistJobBoard`: only the first board mutation in a window appends; the rest coalesce behind a trailing flush (real 30 s Timer) or the graceful shutdown flush. A SIGKILL runs neither. The PTY scenario launches 5 jobs inside one window then `hardKill`s — the file's last snapshot carries only job 1, so `_rehydrateJobBoard` demotes 1 live card to lost. Not a compaction/repair eviction: `repairKeepLatestCustomTypes` and the resume-time reader keep the LATEST snapshot; the records never reached the file. Pre-#1594 every mutation appended, which is why the baseline was green.

## Fix
Live-set GROWTH (a job started) bypasses the persist window — each start appends immediately, so the last snapshot always carries every started job and the invariant `lost == seeded live` holds. Settles keep riding the window: an unpersisted settle only overcounts `lost` on a crash (conservative — still never "running"). The gh-1590 diet stays in force for terminal churn; its wiring-test pin is revised to `<= starts + 1` with rationale.

- `shell_job_ledger_caps_test.dart` + `subagent_registry_caps_test.dart` 18/18 green.
- The PTY repro itself needs a real pty (`openpty` is blocked in this dev sandbox) — CI nightly is its gate.

Closes #1622"

Future<void> _rehydrateJobBoard() async {
  final session = _session;
  if (session == null) return;

The stale deduper could SUPPRESS a needed append: switch to session B (no registry records), board still holds session A's cards; first mutation in B (e.g., a NEW job starts in B) → grewLive vs stale ids → new id → append → fine. Do not ask for identifiers; the context is already available locally. ```mermaid flowchart TD G1["⚠️ Review Guidelines — evaluate against existing codebase patterns"] G2["Before reviewing, explore the project's code structure, architecture, and testing patterns"] G3["If AGENTS.md exists → READ it — defines coding styles to check against"] G4["Flag deviations from established patterns unless justified in PR description"] G1 --> G2 --> G3 --> G4 ``` # PR Review General Guidelines ## Review flow ```mermaid flowchart TD START([PR ready for review]) --> READ["1. re-read changed files,
surface ALL remaining issues"] EXHAUST --> OUTPUT["8. Write outputs:
pr_review.json · pr_review_general.md · pr_review_comments/*.md"] OUTPUT --> END([End]) ``` ## 1. Input context — MANDATORY reading order ```mermaid flowchart TD subgraph PR_CONTEXT["⚠️ PR-specific files (read first)"] P1["1️⃣ instruction.md (repo root) — project stack, conventions"] P2["2️⃣ input/TICKET/pr_info.md — PR title, author, branch, description"] P3["3️⃣ input/TICKET/pr_diff.txt — the diff to review"] P4["4️⃣ input/TICKET/pr_files.txt — list of changed files"] P5["5️⃣ input/TICKET/ci_failures.md — CI failures = BLOCKING (last 500 lines)"] P5_FULL["5️⃣ input/TICKET/ci_failures_full.log — full CI logs"] P6["6️⃣ input/TICKET/pr_discussions.md + pr_discussions_raw.json — existing comments"] P1 --> P2 --> P3 --> P4 --> P5 --> P5_FULL --> P6 end subgraph TICKET_CONTEXT["Ticket context (for understanding PR purpose)"] T1["7️⃣ input/TICKET/ticket.md — linked ticket description, ACs"] T2["8️⃣ input/TICKET/comments.md — ticket discussion if present"] T3["9️⃣ input/TICKET/parent-*.md — parent story context"] T4["🔟 input/TICKET/confluence/*.md — linked specifications"] T1 --> T2 --> T3 --> T4 end subgraph RULE["⚠️ Rule"] R1["If file exists in input/ → read locally, do NOT re-fetch via dmtools"] end PR_CONTEXT --> TICKET_CONTEXT --> RULE ``` Read PR files to understand WHAT changed. Read ticket files to understand WHY it changed and verify against requirements. ## 2. Diff checklist — apply to `pr_diff.txt` For every hunk, ask at least these questions: - [ ] Does the change match the ticket scope? Any scope creep? - [ ] Are new or changed public APIs contract-safe for existing callers? - [ ] Is user/external input validated, sanitized, or escaped? - [ ] Are secrets, tokens, or PATs handled safely — not logged, not interpolated into shell scripts? - [ ] Are new or modified files present under `testing/` in a non-test-automation PR? - [ ] Is dead code, unused imports, or obvious duplication introduced? - [ ] Are error paths handled, or are failures silently swallowed? - [ ] Are new dependencies justified and compatible with the existing stack? - [ ] Beyond blockers: what other maintainability, correctness, or quality improvements are visible in the changed code? ## 3. Changed-file deep read Do not review from the diff alone. Read the full content of every changed file: - imports and dependencies - class/method responsibilities and adherence to SRP / OOP principles - naming consistency with the rest of the codebase - error handling, logging, and edge cases - test coverage for changed behavior - backward-compatibility and migration impact ## 4. Impact analysis (CodeGraph or grep fallback) Use CodeGraph to find "what could break": - `codegraph_callers` / `codegraph_callees` on modified public symbols - `codegraph_search` for: `PAT_TOKEN`, `secrets.`, `github.token`, `previousViewModel` - `codegraph_impact` before flagging architectural changes **If CodeGraph unavailable**, use grep and document it: ```bash grep -rn "changedFunctionName" --include="*.ts" . grep -rn "secrets\.\|github\.token" . ``` ## 5. Review dimensions Rate the PR across all relevant dimensions: | Dimension | What to check | |---|---| | **Security** | injection, unsafe interpolation, secret leakage, missing permissions, unsafe defaults | | **Architecture / OOP** | SRP, coupling, abstraction consistency, provider/repository boundaries | | **Code quality** | naming, complexity, error handling, logging, comments | | **Tests** | coverage for new/changed paths, meaningful assertions, no brittle string-only tests | | **Duplication** | copy-paste, duplicated logic across files, duplicated configuration | | **Backward compatibility** | public API changes, migration paths, default behavior | | **Performance** | unnecessary rebuilds, heavy sync operations, missing timeouts | | **Workflow / CI safety** | (when `.github/workflows/` changes) secret declarations, ref pinning, permissions, timeouts | ## 6. Severity classification Classify every finding before writing outputs: - **BLOCKING** — merge would cause a bug, security issue, data loss, or CI break. Must be fixed. - **IMPORTANT** — real maintainability or correctness issue. Strongly prefer fixing before merge. - **SUGGESTION** — optional improvement, style, or future polish. Does not block merge. When in doubt, start one level higher; downgrade only after confirming the risk is negligible. ## 7. Exhaustive single-pass review Treat **every** review as the final and only review pass. The author will not get another chance to catch missed findings cheaply. - Do not defer SUGGESTION or IMPORTANT items to a later round because a BLOCKING issue exists. - After classifying all findings, re-read every changed file and ask: *"What else is improvable here?"* - Before writing outputs, verify that no obvious quality, maintainability, or correctness issue was left unreported. - Aim to surface the maximum number of actionable findings in this single iteration. ## 8. Outputs Write the standard review artifacts: - `outputs/pr_review.json` — structured data with `recommendation`, `summary`, `inlineComments`, `issueCounts` - `outputs/pr_review_general.md` — 1-2 paragraph general PR comment - `outputs/pr_review_comments/*.md` — one file per detailed inline comment **Inline comment lines must be present in the PR diff.** GitHub review threads can only be attached to added or context lines inside a diff hunk. If `pr_diff.txt` is truncated, run `git diff origin/{baseBranch}...HEAD` to locate the correct line numbers. Findings on unchanged code outside the diff belong in `outputs/pr_review_general.md`, not as inline comments. Do NOT write `outputs/response.md`; the review is posted to GitHub only. ```mermaid flowchart TD O1["Write outputs/pr_review.json — structured data for GitHub PR review…

# Pull Request Information

- **PR #**: 1623
- **URL**: https://github.com/IstiN/flutter_agent_harness/pull/1623
- **Title**: fix(1622): shell_job_registry persist window strands live jobs off the record on crash
- **Author**: vabhzw17eg2qu4m9-bit
- **Branch**: `fix/1622-job-board-restart-lost-count` → `main`
- **State**: open
- **Files Changed**: 3
- **Additions**: +117
- **Deletions**: -9
- **Created**: 2026-10-15T04:09:00Z
- **Updated**: 2026-10-15T04:18:06Z

## PR Description

## Problem
Nightly PTY red: `test/integration/job_board_stability_pty_test.dart:420` "restart with live jobs shows lost, never running" expects `5 background tasks lost`, got `✗ 1 background task lost on restart (process gone, no exit reported)` (run 38676570867, main 28927a1b0f). Green in the Oct-13/14 nightlies.

## Root cause
Culprit: 872f3ccc47 (gh-1590/#1594 — session JSONL diet). Its `LedgerSnapshotThrottle` (30 s `ledgerSnapshotPersistInterval`) rate-bounds `shell_job_registry` appends in `_persistJobBoard`: only the first board mutation in a window appends; the rest coalesce behind a trailing flush (real 30 s Timer) or the graceful shutdown flush. A SIGKILL runs neither. The PTY scenario launches 5 jobs inside one window then `hardKill`s — the file's last snapshot carries only job 1, so `_rehydrateJobBoard` demotes 1 live card to lost. Not a compaction/repair eviction: `repairKeepLatestCustomTypes` and the resume-time reader keep the LATEST snapshot; the records never reached the file. Pre-#1594 every mutation appended, which is why the baseline was green.

## Fix
Live-set GROWTH (a job started) bypasses the persist window — each start appends immediately, so the last snapshot always carries every started job and the invariant `lost == seeded live` holds. Settles keep riding the window: an unpersisted settle only overcounts `lost` on a crash (conservative — still never "running"). The gh-1590 diet stays in force for terminal churn; its wiring-test pin is revised to `<= starts + 1` with rationale.

## Gates
- `dart analyze` clean on touched files (lib/src/cli/agent_cli.dart, lib/src/cli/agent_hub_cli.dart, test/cli/shell_job_ledger_throttle_wiring_test.dart); `dart format` applied.
- `test/cli/shell_job_ledger_throttle_wiring_test.dart` 3/3 green, incl. a new crash-moment regression test (real AgentCli, frozen `ledgerClock`: at the SIGKILL-equivalent point the session file must already carry all 5 jobs as running). Verified the new test FAILS pre-fix (lib change stashed) and passes post-fix.
- `shell_job_ledger_caps_test.dart` + `subagent_registry_caps_test.dart` 18/18 green.
- The PTY repro itself needs a real pty (`openpty` is blocked in this dev sandbox) — CI nightly is its gate.

Closes #1622

# AGENTS.md

Conventions for AI agents and contributors in this repository. Keep it
factual: paths, commands, invariants — no essays.

## Project layout

- `lib/` — the `flutter_agent_harness` package (pure Dart core). `test/`
  mirrors it. `prompts/` — all LLM prompts as Markdown (see rules below).
- `lib/flutter_agent_harness.dart` (the barrel) — gh-1232 policy:
  GROUPED APPEND-ONLY export sections, one `// ── <subsystem> ──` comment
  header per group, exports sorted by path within a group, new exports
  appended to their subsystem group (a new subsystem starts a new group).
  No per-subsystem mini-barrels, no re-sorting of existing lines — append
  only, so parallel edits almost never touch the same line.
- God-file ceiling (gh-1232): no Dart file over 2800 lines anywhere
  (crap4dart `loc` gate, `max_lines: 2800` — issue #1234 migrated the
  shell guards; enforced whole-tree in CI and on staged files by the
  pre-commit hook. Scope: core `lib bin` via `crap4dart.yaml` +
  `test example` via the `crap4dart.loc-scope.yaml` companion config
  (0.11.0 has no per-gate sources override), flutter_app/lib via
  `flutter_app/crap4dart.yaml`).
  Target < 2000 for primary
  files; when a file approaches it, split by concern into `part` files
  (the established pattern: `agent_cli.dart`, `builtin_tools.dart`,

  `agent_service_*.dart` mixins) — never by extracting public API.

  "key": "pr-1623",
  "fields": {
    "summary": "fix(1622): shell_job_registry persist window strands live jobs off the record on crash",
    "description": "## Problem
Nightly PTY red: `test/integration/job_board_stability_pty_test.dart:420` "restart with live jobs shows lost, never running" expects `5 background tasks lost`, got `✗ 1 background task lost on restart (process gone, no exit reported)` (run 38676570867, main 28927a1b0f). Green in the Oct-13/14 nightlies.

## Root cause
Culprit: 872f3ccc47 (gh-1590/#1594 — session JSONL diet). Its `LedgerSnapshotThrottle` (30 s `ledgerSnapshotPersistInterval`) rate-bounds `shell_job_registry` appends in `_persistJobBoard`: only the first board mutation in a window appends; the rest coalesce behind a trailing flush (real 30 s Timer) or the graceful shutdown flush. A SIGKILL runs neither. The PTY scenario launches 5 jobs inside one window then `hardKill`s — the file's last snapshot carries only job 1, so `_rehydrateJobBoard` demotes 1 live card to lost. Not a compaction/repair eviction: `repairKeepLatestCustomTypes` and the resume-time reader keep the LATEST snapshot; the records never reached the file. Pre-#1594 every mutation appended, which is why the baseline was green.

## Fix
Live-set GROWTH (a job started) bypasses the persist window — each start appends immediately, so the last snapshot always carries every started job and the invariant `lost == seeded live` holds. Settles keep riding the window: an unpersisted settle only overcounts `lost` on a crash (conservative — still never "running"). The gh-1590 diet stays in force for terminal churn; its wiring-test pin is revised to `<= starts + 1` with rationale.

- `dart analyze` clean on touched files (lib/src/cli/agent_cli.dart, lib/src/cli/agent_hub_cli.dart, test/cli/shell_job_ledger_throttle_wiring_test.dart); `dart format` applied.

Verified the new test FAILS pre-fix (lib change stashed) and passes post-fix.
- `shell_job_ledger_caps_test.dart` + `subagent_registry_caps_test.dart` 18/18 green.
- The PTY repro itself needs a real pty (`openpty` is blocked in this dev sandbox) — CI nightly is its gate.

Closes #1622"
