- **Title**: fix(1622): shell_job_registry persist window strands live jobs off the record on crash
- **Author**: vabhzw17eg2qu4m9-bit
- **Branch**: `fix/1622-job-board-restart-lost-count` → `main`
- **State**: open
- **Files Changed**: 3
- **Additions**: +117
- **Deletions**: -9
- **Created**: 2026-10-15T04:09:00Z
- **Updated**: 2026-10-15T04:18:06Z

## PR Description

## Problem
Nightly PTY red: `test/integration/job_board_stability_pty_test.dart:420` "restart with live jobs shows lost, never running" expects `5 background tasks lost`, got `✗ 1 background task lost on restart (process gone, no exit reported)` (run 38676570867, main 28927a1b0f). Green in the Oct-13/14 nightlies.

## Root cause
Culprit: 872f3ccc47 (gh-1590/#1594 — session JSONL diet). Its `LedgerSnapshotThrottle` (30 s `ledgerSnapshotPersistInterval`) rate-bounds `shell_job_registry` appends in `_persistJobBoard`: only the first board mutation in a window appends; the rest coalesce behind a trailing flush (real 30 s Timer) or the graceful shutdown flush. A SIGKILL runs neither. The PTY scenario launches 5 jobs inside one window then `hardKill`s — the file's last snapshot carries only job 1, so `_rehydrateJobBoard` demotes 1 live card to lost. Not a compaction/repair eviction: `repairKeepLatestCustomTypes` and the resume-time reader keep the LATEST snapshot; the records never reached the file. Pre-#1594 every mutation appended, which is why the baseline was green.

## Fix
Live-set GROWTH (a job started) bypasses the persist window — each start appends immediately, so the last snapshot always carries every started job and the invariant `lost == seeded live` holds. Settles keep riding the window: an unpersisted settle only overcounts `lost` on a crash (conservative — still never "running"). The gh-1590 diet stays in force for terminal churn; its wiring-test pin is revised to `<= starts + 1` with rationale.

## Gates
- `dart analyze` clean on touched files (lib/src/cli/agent_cli.dart, lib/src/cli/agent_hub_cli.dart, test/cli/shell_job_ledger_throttle_wiring_test.dart); `dart format` applied.
- `test/cli/shell_job_ledger_throttle_wiring_test.dart` 3/3 green, incl. a new crash-moment regression test (real AgentCli, frozen `ledgerClock`: at the SIGKILL-equivalent point the session file must already carry all 5 jobs as running). Verified the new test FAILS pre-fix (lib change stashed) and passes post-fix.
- `shell_job_ledger_caps_test.dart` + `subagent_registry_caps_test.dart` 18/18 green.
- The PTY repro itself needs a real pty (`openpty` is blocked in this dev sandbox) — CI nightly is its gate.

Closes #1622

# AGENTS.md

factual: paths, commands, invariants — no essays.

## Project layout

- `lib/` — the `flutter_agent_harness` package (pure Dart core). `test/`
  mirrors it. `prompts/` — all LLM prompts as Markdown (see rules below).
- `lib/flutter_agent_harness.dart` (the barrel) — gh-1232 policy:
  GROUPED APPEND-ONLY export sections, one `// ── <subsystem> ──` comment
  header per group, exports sorted by path within a group, new exports
  appended to their subsystem group (a new subsystem starts a new group).
  No per-subsystem mini-barrels, no re-sorting of existing lines — append
  only, so parallel edits almost never touch the same line.
- God-file ceiling (gh-1232): no Dart file over 2800 lines anywhere

  pre-commit hook. Scope: core `lib bin` via `crap4dart.yaml` +

  (0.11.0 has no per-gate sources override), flutter_app/lib via
  `flutter_app/crap4dart.yaml`).
  Target < 2000 for primary

1. **Correctness of the grewLive logic**: 
   - `_jobBoardPersistedLiveIds` is null until first append. First mutation after reset: `grewLive` = false (since null). So the first snapshot rides the window (per gh-1590 diet). If the FIRST job start is the first board mutation and the throttle refuses, then the first start does not persist. Wait — in the crash repro: the PTY scenario launches 5 jobs inside one window then hardKills. With the fix: job 1's start → first mutation → `_jobBoardPersistedLiveIds == null` → `grewLive == false` → rides the window... but does it append?     "description": "## Problem
Nightly PTY red: `test/integration/job_board_stability_pty_test.dart:420` "restart with live jobs shows lost, never running" expects `5 background tasks lost`, got `✗ 1 background task lost on restart (process gone, no exit reported)` (run 38676570867, main 28927a1b0f). Green in the Oct-13/14 nightlies.

## Root cause
Culprit: 872f3ccc47 (gh-1590/#1594 — session JSONL diet). Its `LedgerSnapshotThrottle` (30 s `ledgerSnapshotPersistInterval`) rate-bounds `shell_job_registry` appends in `_persistJobBoard`: only the first board mutation in a window appends; the rest coalesce behind a trailing flush (real 30 s Timer) or the graceful shutdown flush. A SIGKILL runs neither. The PTY scenario launches 5 jobs inside one window then `hardKill`s — the file's last snapshot carries only job 1, so `_rehydrateJobBoard` demotes 1 live card to lost. Not a compaction/repair eviction: `repairKeepLatestCustomTypes` and the resume-time reader keep the LATEST snapshot; the records never reached the file. Pre-#1594 every mutation appended, which is why the baseline was green.

## Fix
Live-set GROWTH (a job started) bypasses the persist window — each start appends immediately, so the last snapshot always carries every started job and the invariant `lost == seeded live` holds. Settles keep riding the window: an unpersisted settle only overcounts `lost` on a crash (conservative — still never "running"). The gh-1590 diet stays in force for terminal churn; its wiring-test pin is revised to `<= starts + 1` with rationale.

Nightly PTY red: `test/integration/job_board_stability_pty_test.dart:420` "restart with live jobs shows lost, never running" expects `5 background tasks lost`, got `✗ 1 background task lost on restart (process gone, no exit reported)` (run 38676570867, main 28927a1b0f). Green in the Oct-13/14 nightlies.

## Root cause
Culprit: 872f3ccc47 (gh-1590/#1594 — session JSONL diet). Its `LedgerSnapshotThrottle` (30 s `ledgerSnapshotPersistInterval`) rate-bounds `shell_job_registry` appends in `_persistJobBoard`: only the first board mutation in a window appends; the rest coalesce behind a trailing flush (real 30 s Timer) or the graceful shutdown flush. A SIGKILL runs neither. The PTY scenario launches 5 jobs inside one window then `hardKill`s — the file's last snapshot carries only job 1, so `_rehydrateJobBoard` demotes 1 live card to lost. Not a compaction/repair eviction: `repairKeepLatestCustomTypes` and the resume-time reader keep the LATEST snapshot; the records never reached the file. Pre-#1594 every mutation appended, which is why the baseline was green.

## Fix
Live-set GROWTH (a job started) bypasses the persist window — each start appends immediately, so the last snapshot always carries every started job and the invariant `lost == seeded live` holds. Settles keep riding the window: an unpersisted settle only overcounts `lost` on a crash (conservative — still never "running"). The gh-1590 diet stays in force for terminal churn; its wiring-test pin is revised to `<= starts + 1` with rationale.

- `dart analyze` clean on touched files (lib/src/cli/agent_cli.dart, lib/src/cli/agent_hub_cli.dart, test/cli/shell_job_ledger_throttle_wiring_test.dart); `dart format` applied.

Verified the new test FAILS pre-fix (lib change stashed) and passes post-fix.
- `shell_job_ledger_caps_test.dart` + `subagent_registry_caps_test.dart` 18/18 green.
- The PTY repro itself needs a real pty (`openpty` is blocked in this dev sandbox) — CI nightly is its gate.

Closes #1622

  "key": "pr-1623",
  "fields": {
    "summary": "fix(1622): shell_job_registry persist window strands live jobs off the record on crash",
    "description": "## Problem
Nightly PTY red: `test/integration/job_board_stability_pty_test.dart:420` "restart with live jobs shows lost, never running" expects `5 background tasks lost`, got `✗ 1 background task lost on restart (process gone, no exit reported)` (run 38676570867, main 28927a1b0f). Green in the Oct-13/14 nightlies.

## Root cause
Culprit: 872f3ccc47 (gh-1590/#1594 — session JSONL diet). Its `LedgerSnapshotThrottle` (30 s `ledgerSnapshotPersistInterval`) rate-bounds `shell_job_registry` appends in `_persistJobBoard`: only the first board mutation in a window appends; the rest coalesce behind a trailing flush (real 30 s Timer) or the graceful shutdown flush. A SIGKILL runs neither. The PTY scenario launches 5 jobs inside one window then `hardKill`s — the file's last snapshot carries only job 1, so `_rehydrateJobBoard` demotes 1 live card to lost. Not a compaction/repair eviction: `repairKeepLatestCustomTypes` and the resume-time reader keep the LATEST snapshot; the records never reached the file. Pre-#1594 every mutation appended, which is why the baseline was green.

## Fix
Live-set GROWTH (a job started) bypasses the persist window — each start appends immediately, so the last snapshot always carries every started job and the invariant `lost == seeded live` holds. Settles keep riding the window: an unpersisted settle only overcounts `lost` on a crash (conservative — still never "running"). The gh-1590 diet stays in force for terminal churn; its wiring-test pin is revised to `<= starts + 1` with rationale.

## Gates
- `dart analyze` clean on touched files (lib/src/cli/agent_cli.dart, lib/src/cli/agent_hub_cli.dart, test/cli/shell_job_ledger_throttle_wiring_test.dart); `dart format` applied.
- `test/cli/shell_job_ledger_throttle_wiring_test.dart` 3/3 green, incl. a new crash-moment regression test (real AgentCli, frozen `ledgerClock`: at the SIGKILL-equivalent point the session file must already carry all 5 jobs as running). Verified the new test FAILS pre-fix (lib change stashed) and passes post-fix.
- `shell_job_ledger_caps_test.dart` + `subagent_registry_caps_test.dart` 18/18 green.
- The PTY repro itself needs a real pty (`openpty` is blocked in this dev sandbox) — CI nightly is its gate.

Closes #1622"
  }

- **Author**: vabhzw17eg2qu4m9-bit
- **Branch**: `fix/1622-job-board-restart-lost-count` → `main`
- **State**: open
- **Files Changed**: 3
- **Additions**: +117
- **Deletions**: -9
- **Created**: 2026-10-15T04:09:00Z
- **Updated**: 2026-10-15T04:18:06Z

## PR Description

## Problem
Nightly PTY red: `test/integration/job_board_stability_pty_test.dart:420` "restart with live jobs shows lost, never running" expects `5 background tasks lost`, got `✗ 1 background task lost on restart (process gone, no exit reported)` (run 38676570867, main 28927a1b0f). Green in the Oct-13/14 nightlies.

## Root cause
Culprit: 872f3ccc47 (gh-1590/#1594 — session JSONL diet). Its `LedgerSnapshotThrottle` (30 s `ledgerSnapshotPersistInterval`) rate-bounds `shell_job_registry` appends in `_persistJobBoard`: only the first board mutation in a window appends; the rest coalesce behind a trailing flush (real 30 s Timer) or the graceful shutdown flush. A SIGKILL runs neither. The PTY scenario launches 5 jobs inside one window then `hardKill`s — the file's last snapshot carries only job 1, so `_rehydrateJobBoard` demotes 1 live card to lost. Not a compaction/repair eviction: `repairKeepLatestCustomTypes` and the resume-time reader keep the LATEST snapshot; the records never reached the file. Pre-#1594 every mutation appended, which is why the baseline was green.

## Fix
Live-set GROWTH (a job started) bypasses the persist window — each start appends immediately, so the last snapshot always carries every started job and the invariant `lost == seeded live` holds. Settles keep riding the window: an unpersisted settle only overcounts `lost` on a crash (conservative — still never "running"). The gh-1590 diet stays in force for terminal churn; its wiring-test pin is revised to `<= starts + 1` with rationale.

## Gates
- `dart analyze` clean on touched files (lib/src/cli/agent_cli.dart, lib/src/cli/agent_hub_cli.dart, test/cli/shell_job_ledger_throttle_wiring_test.dart); `dart format` applied.
- `test/cli/shell_job_ledger_throttle_wiring_test.dart` 3/3 green, incl. a new crash-moment regression test (real AgentCli, frozen `ledgerClock`: at the SIGKILL-equivalent point the session file must already carry all 5 jobs as running). Verified the new test FAILS pre-fix (lib change stashed) and passes post-fix.
- `shell_job_ledger_caps_test.dart` + `subagent_registry_caps_test.dart` 18/18 green.
- The PTY repro itself needs a real pty (`openpty` is blocked in this dev sandbox) — CI nightly is its gate.

Closes #1622

# AGENTS.md

Conventions for AI agents and contributors in this repository. Keep it
factual: paths, commands, invariants — no essays.

## Project layout

- `lib/` — the `flutter_agent_harness` package (pure Dart core). `test/`
  mirrors it. `prompts/` — all LLM prompts as Markdown (see rules below).
- `lib/flutter_agent_harness.dart` (the barrel) — gh-1232 policy:
  GROUPED APPEND-ONLY export sections, one `// ── <subsystem> ──` comment
  header per group, exports sorted by path within a group, new exports
  appended to their subsystem group (a new subsystem starts a new group).
  No per-subsystem mini-barrels, no re-sorting of existing lines — append
  only, so parallel edits almost never touch the same line.
- God-file ceiling (gh-1232): no Dart file over 2800 lines anywhere
  (crap4dart `loc` gate, `max_lines: 2800` — issue #1234 migrated the
  shell guards; enforced whole-tree in CI and on staged files by the
  pre-commit hook. Scope: core `lib bin` via `crap4dart.yaml` +
  `test example` via the `crap4dart.loc-scope.yaml` companion config
  (0.11.0 has no per-gate sources override), flutter_app/lib via
  `flutter_app/crap4dart.yaml`).
  Target < 2000 for primary
  files; when a file approaches it, split by concern into `part` files
  (the established pattern: `agent_cli.dart`, `builtin_tools.dart`,
  `bin/fah.dart` → `bin/fah_*.dart`, `agent_service.dart` →
  `agent_service_*.dart` mixins) — never by extracting public API.
- `lib/src/approval/` — tool approval gate: tiers (read/write/exec),
  session modes (always-ask/write/yolo/autopilot — the CLI label of the
  `unattended` enum), per-tool overrides,
  critical-pattern
  `bash` interceptor, per-turn grants (`grantForTurn(allow:, deny:)` —
  skill `allowed-tools`/`disallowed-tools` manifest keys ride these for one
  turn; explicit deny > turnDeny > per-tool override > turnAllow >
  alwaysAllow > mode (critical bash outranks mode in always-ask/write/yolo,
  but is skipped in unattended so the mode never blocks — for runs with no

  on every new user

## Root cause
Culprit: 872f3ccc47 (gh-1590/#1594 — session JSONL diet). Its `LedgerSnapshotThrottle` (30 s `ledgerSnapshotPersistInterval`) rate-bounds `shell_job_registry` appends in `_persistJobBoard`: only the first board mutation in a window appends; the rest coalesce behind a trailing flush (real 30 s Timer) or the graceful shutdown flush. A SIGKILL runs neither. The PTY scenario launches 5 jobs inside one window then `hardKill`s — the file's last snapshot carries only job 1, so `_rehydrateJobBoard` demotes 1 live card to lost. Not a compaction/repair eviction: `repairKeepLatestCustomTypes` and the resume-time reader keep the LATEST snapshot; the records never reached the file. Pre-#1594 every mutation appended, which is why the baseline was green.

## Fix
Live-set GROWTH (a job started) bypasses the persist window — each start appends immediately, so the last snapshot always carries every started job and the invariant `lost == seeded live` holds. Settles keep riding the window: an unpersisted settle only overcounts `lost` on a crash (conservative — still never "running"). The gh-1590 diet stays in force for terminal churn; its wiring-test pin is revised to `<= starts + 1` with rationale.

# Pull Request Information

- **PR #**: 1623
- **URL**: https://github.com/IstiN/flutter_agent_harness/pull/1623
- **Title**: fix(1622): shell_job_registry persist window strands live jobs off the record on crash
- **Author**: vabhzw17eg2qu4m9-bit
- **Branch**: `fix/1622-job-board-restart-lost-count` → `main`
- **State**: open
- **Files Changed**: 3
- **Additions**: +117
- **Deletions**: -9
- **Created**: 2026-10-15T04:09:00Z
- **Updated**: 2026-10-15T04:18:06Z

## PR Description

## Problem
Nightly PTY red: `test/integration/job_board_stability_pty_test.dart:420` "restart with live jobs shows lost, never running" expects `5 background tasks lost`, got `✗ 1 background task lost on restart (process gone, no exit reported)` (run 38676570867, main 28927a1b0f). Green in the Oct-13/14 nightlies.

## Root cause
Culprit: 872f3ccc47 (gh-1590/#1594 — session JSONL diet). Its `LedgerSnapshotThrottle` (30 s `ledgerSnapshotPersistInterval`) rate-bounds `shell_job_registry` appends in `_persistJobBoard`: only the first board mutation in a window appends; the rest coalesce behind a trailing flush (real 30 s Timer) or the graceful shutdown flush. A SIGKILL runs neither. The PTY scenario launches 5 jobs inside one window then `hardKill`s — the file's last snapshot carries only job 1, so `_rehydrateJobBoard` demotes 1 live card to lost. Not a compaction/repair eviction: `repairKeepLatestCustomTypes` and the resume-time reader keep the LATEST snapshot; the records never reached the file. Pre-#1594 every mutation appended, which is why the baseline was green.

## Fix
Live-set GROWTH (a job started) bypasses the persist window — each start appends immediately, so the last snapshot always carries every started job and the invariant `lost == seeded live` holds. Settles keep riding the window: an unpersisted settle only overcounts `lost` on a crash (conservative — still never "running"). The gh-1590 diet stays in force for terminal churn; its wiring-test pin is revised to `<= starts + 1` with rationale.

## Gates
- `dart analyze` clean on touched files (lib/src/cli/agent_cli.dart, lib/src/cli/agent_hub_cli.dart, test/cli/shell_job_ledger_throttle_wiring_test.dart); `dart format` applied.
- `test/cli/shell_job_ledger_throttle_wiring_test.dart` 3/3 green, incl. a new crash-moment regression test (real AgentCli, frozen `ledgerClock`: at the SIGKILL-equivalent point the session file must already carry all 5 jobs as running). Verified the new test FAILS pre-fix (lib change stashed) and passes post-fix.
- `shell_job_ledger_caps_test.dart` + `subagent_registry_caps_test.dart` 18/18 green.
- The PTY repro itself needs a real pty (`openpty` is blocked in this dev sandbox) — CI nightly is its gate.

Closes #1622

# AGENTS.md

Conventions for AI agents and contributors in this repository. Keep it
factual: paths, commands, invariants — no essays.

## Project layout

- `lib/` — the `flutter_agent_harness` package (pure Dart core). `test/`
  mirrors it. `prompts/` — all LLM prompts as Markdown (see rules below).
- `lib/flutter_agent_harness.dart` (the barrel) — gh-1232 policy:
  GROUPED APPEND-ONLY export sections, one `// ── <subsystem> ──` comment
  header per group, exports sorted by path within a group, new exports
  appended to their subsystem group (a new subsystem starts a new group).
  No per-subsystem mini-barrels, no re-sorting of existing lines — append
  only, so parallel edits almost never touch the same line.
- God-file ceiling (gh-1232): no Dart file over 2800 lines anywhere
  (crap4dart `loc` gate, `max_lines: 2800` — issue #1234 migrated the
  shell guards; enforced whole-tree in CI and on staged files by the
  pre-commit hook. Scope: core `lib bin` via `crap4dart.yaml` +
  `test example` via the `crap4dart.loc-scope.yaml` companion config
  (0.11.0 has no per-gate sources override), flutter_app/lib via
  `flutter_app/crap4dart.yaml`).
  Target < 2000 for primary
  files; when a file approaches it, split by concern into `part` files
  (the established pattern: `agent_cli.dart`, `builtin_tools.dart`,

  `agent_service_*.dart` mixins) — never by extracting public API.

    "summary": "fix(1622): shell_job_registry persist window strands live jobs off the record on crash",
    "description": "## Problem
Nightly PTY red: `test/integration/job_board_stability_pty_test.dart:420` "restart with live jobs shows lost, never running" expects `5 background tasks lost`, got `✗ 1 background task lost on restart (process gone, no exit reported)` (run 38676570867, main 28927a1b0f). Green in the Oct-13/14 nightlies.

## Root cause
Culprit: 872f3ccc47 (gh-1590/#1594 — session JSONL diet). Its `LedgerSnapshotThrottle` (30 s `ledgerSnapshotPersistInterval`) rate-bounds `shell_job_registry` appends in `_persistJobBoard`: only the first board mutation in a window appends; the rest coalesce behind a trailing flush (real 30 s Timer) or the graceful shutdown flush. A SIGKILL runs neither. The PTY scenario launches 5 jobs inside one window then `hardKill`s — the file's last snapshot carries only job 1, so `_rehydrateJobBoard` demotes 1 live card to lost. Not a compaction/repair eviction: `repairKeepLatestCustomTypes` and the resume-time reader keep the LATEST snapshot; the records never reached the file. Pre-#1594 every mutation appended, which is why the baseline was green.

## Fix
Live-set GROWTH (a job started) bypasses the persist window — each start appends immediately, so the last snapshot always carries every started job and the invariant `lost == seeded live` holds. Settles keep riding the window: an unpersisted settle only overcounts `lost` on a crash (conservative — still never "running"). The gh-1590 diet stays in force for terminal churn; its wiring-test pin is revised to `<= starts + 1` with rationale.

- `shell_job_ledger_caps_test.dart` + `subagent_registry_caps_test.dart` 18/18 green.
- The PTY repro itself needs a real pty (`openpty` is blocked in this dev sandbox) — CI nightly is its gate.

Closes #1622"

- **Title**: fix(1622): shell_job_registry persist window strands live jobs off the record on crash
- **Author**: vabhzw17eg2qu4m9-bit
- **Branch**: `fix/1622-job-board-restart-lost-count` → `main`
- **State**: open
- **Files Changed**: 3
- **Additions**: +117
- **Deletions**: -9
- **Created**: 2026-10-15T04:09:00Z
- **Updated**: 2026-10-15T04:18:06Z

## PR Description

## Problem
Nightly PTY red: `test/integration/job_board_stability_pty_test.dart:420` "restart with live jobs shows lost, never running" expects `5 background tasks lost`, got `✗ 1 background task lost on restart (process gone, no exit reported)` (run 38676570867, main 28927a1b0f). Green in the Oct-13/14 nightlies.

## Root cause
Culprit: 872f3ccc47 (gh-1590/#1594 — session JSONL diet). Its `LedgerSnapshotThrottle` (30 s `ledgerSnapshotPersistInterval`) rate-bounds `shell_job_registry` appends in `_persistJobBoard`: only the first board mutation in a window appends; the rest coalesce behind a trailing flush (real 30 s Timer) or the graceful shutdown flush. A SIGKILL runs neither. The PTY scenario launches 5 jobs inside one window then `hardKill`s — the file's last snapshot carries only job 1, so `_rehydrateJobBoard` demotes 1 live card to lost. Not a compaction/repair eviction: `repairKeepLatestCustomTypes` and the resume-time reader keep the LATEST snapshot; the records never reached the file. Pre-#1594 every mutation appended, which is why the baseline was green.

## Fix
Live-set GROWTH (a job started) bypasses the persist window — each start appends immediately, so the last snapshot always carries every started job and the invariant `lost == seeded live` holds. Settles keep riding the window: an unpersisted settle only overcounts `lost` on a crash (conservative — still never "running"). The gh-1590 diet stays in force for terminal churn; its wiring-test pin is revised to `<= starts + 1` with rationale.

## Gates
- `dart analyze` clean on touched files (lib/src/cli/agent_cli.dart, lib/src/cli/agent_hub_cli.dart, test/cli/shell_job_ledger_throttle_wiring_test.dart); `dart format` applied.
- `test/cli/shell_job_ledger_throttle_wiring_test.dart` 3/3 green, incl. a new crash-moment regression test (real AgentCli, frozen `ledgerClock`: at the SIGKILL-equivalent point the session file must already carry all 5 jobs as running). Verified the new test FAILS pre-fix (lib change stashed) and passes post-fix.
- `shell_job_ledger_caps_test.dart` + `subagent_registry_caps_test.dart` 18/18 green.
- The PTY repro itself needs a real pty (`openpty` is blocked in this dev sandbox) — CI nightly is its gate.

Closes #1622

# AGENTS.md

Conventions for AI agents and contributors in this repository. Keep it
factual: paths, commands, invariants — no essays.

## Project layout

- `lib/` — the `flutter_agent_harness` package (pure Dart core). `test/`
  mirrors it. `prompts/` — all LLM prompts as Markdown (see rules below).
- `lib/flutter_agent_harness.dart` (the barrel) — gh-1232 policy:
  GROUPED APPEND-ONLY export sections, one `// ── <subsystem> ──` comment
  header per group, exports sorted by path within a group, new exports
  appended to their subsystem group (a new subsystem starts a new group).
  No per-subsystem mini-barrels, no re-sorting of existing lines — append
  only, so parallel edits almost never touch the same line.
- God-file ceiling (gh-1232): no Dart file over 2800 lines anywhere

  shell guards; enforced whole-tree in CI and on staged files by the
  pre-commit hook. Scope: core `lib bin` via `crap4dart.yaml` +

  Target < 2000 for primary

1. **Correctness of the grewLive logic**: 
   - `_jobBoardPersistedLiveIds` is null until first append. First mutation after reset: `grewLive` = false (since null). So the first snapshot rides the window (per gh-1590 diet). If the FIRST job start is the first board mutation and the throttle refuses, then the first start does not persist. Wait — in the crash repro: the PTY scenario launches 5 jobs inside one window then hardKills. With the fix: job 1's start → first mutation → `_jobBoardPersistedLiveIds == null` → `grewLive == false` → rides the window... but does it append?     "description": "## Problem
Nightly PTY red: `test/integration/job_board_stability_pty_test.dart:420` "restart with live jobs shows lost, never running" expects `5 background tasks lost`, got `✗ 1 background task lost on restart (process gone, no exit reported)` (run 38676570867, main 28927a1b0f). Green in the Oct-13/14 nightlies.

## Root cause
Culprit: 872f3ccc47 (gh-1590/#1594 — session JSONL diet). Its `LedgerSnapshotThrottle` (30 s `ledgerSnapshotPersistInterval`) rate-bounds `shell_job_registry` appends in `_persistJobBoard`: only the first board mutation in a window appends; the rest coalesce behind a trailing flush (real 30 s Timer) or the graceful shutdown flush. A SIGKILL runs neither. The PTY scenario launches 5 jobs inside one window then `hardKill`s — the file's last snapshot carries only job 1, so `_rehydrateJobBoard` demotes 1 live card to lost. Not a compaction/repair eviction: `repairKeepLatestCustomTypes` and the resume-time reader keep the LATEST snapshot; the records never reached the file. Pre-#1594 every mutation appended, which is why the baseline was green.

## Fix
Live-set GROWTH (a job started) bypasses the persist window — each start appends immediately, so the last snapshot always carries every started job and the invariant `lost == seeded live` holds. Settles keep riding the window: an unpersisted settle only overcounts `lost` on a crash (conservative — still never "running"). The gh-1590 diet stays in force for terminal churn; its wiring-test pin is revised to `<= starts + 1` with rationale.

# Pull Request Information

- **PR #**: 1623
- **URL**: https://github.com/IstiN/flutter_agent_harness/pull/1623
- **Title**: fix(1622): shell_job_registry persist window strands live jobs off the record on crash
- **Author**: vabhzw17eg2qu4m9-bit
- **Branch**: `fix/1622-job-board-restart-lost-count` → `main`
- **State**: open
- **Files Changed**: 3
- **Additions**: +117
- **Deletions**: -9
- **Created**: 2026-10-15T04:09:00Z
- **Updated**: 2026-10-15T04:18:06Z

## PR Description

## Problem
Nightly PTY red: `test/integration/job_board_stability_pty_test.dart:420` "restart with live jobs shows lost, never running" expects `5 background tasks lost`, got `✗ 1 background task lost on restart (process gone, no exit reported)` (run 38676570867, main 28927a1b0f). Green in the Oct-13/14 nightlies.

## Root cause
Culprit: 872f3ccc47 (gh-1590/#1594 — session JSONL diet). Its `LedgerSnapshotThrottle` (30 s `ledgerSnapshotPersistInterval`) rate-bounds `shell_job_registry` appends in `_persistJobBoard`: only the first board mutation in a window appends; the rest coalesce behind a trailing flush (real 30 s Timer) or the graceful shutdown flush. A SIGKILL runs neither. The PTY scenario launches 5 jobs inside one window then `hardKill`s — the file's last snapshot carries only job 1, so `_rehydrateJobBoard` demotes 1 live card to lost. Not a compaction/repair eviction: `repairKeepLatestCustomTypes` and the resume-time reader keep the LATEST snapshot; the records never reached the file. Pre-#1594 every mutation appended, which is why the baseline was green.

## Fix
Live-set GROWTH (a job started) bypasses the persist window — each start appends immediately, so the last snapshot always carries every started job and the invariant `lost == seeded live` holds. Settles keep riding the window: an unpersisted settle only overcounts `lost` on a crash (conservative — still never "running"). The gh-1590 diet stays in force for terminal churn; its wiring-test pin is revised to `<= starts + 1` with rationale.

## Gates
- `dart analyze` clean on touched files (lib/src/cli/agent_cli.dart, lib/src/cli/agent_hub_cli.dart, test/cli/shell_job_ledger_throttle_wiring_test.dart); `dart format` applied.
- `test/cli/shell_job_ledger_throttle_wiring_test.dart` 3/3 green, incl. a new crash-moment regression test (real AgentCli, frozen `ledgerClock`: at the SIGKILL-equivalent point the session file must already carry all 5 jobs as running). Verified the new test FAILS pre-fix (lib change stashed) and passes post-fix.
- `shell_job_ledger_caps_test.dart` + `subagent_registry_caps_test.dart` 18/18 green.
- The PTY repro itself needs a real pty (`openpty` is blocked in this dev sandbox) — CI nightly is its gate.

Closes #1622

AGENTS.md
# AGENTS.md

Conventions for AI agents and contributors in this repository. Keep it
factual: paths, commands, invariants — no essays.

## Project layout

- `lib/` — the `flutter_agent_harness` package (pure Dart core). `test/`
  mirrors it. `prompts/` — all LLM prompts as Markdown (see rules below).
- `lib/flutter_agent_harness.dart` (the barrel) — gh-1232 policy:
  GROUPED APPEND-ONLY export sections, one `// ── <subsystem> ──` comment
  header per group, exports sorted by path within a group, new exports
  appended to their subsystem group (a new subsystem starts a new group).
  No per-subsystem mini-barrels, no re-sorting of existing lines — append
  only, so parallel edits almost never touch the same line.
- God-file ceiling (gh-1232): no Dart file over 2800 lines anywhere
  (crap4dart `loc` gate, `max_lines: 2800` — issue #1234 migrated the
  shell guards; enforced whole-tree in CI and on staged files by the
  pre-commit hook. Scope: core `lib bin` via `crap4dart.yaml` +
  `test example` via the `crap4dart.loc-scope.yaml` companion config
  (0.11.0 has no per-gate sources override), flutter_app/lib via
  `flutter_app/crap4dart.yaml`).
  Target < 2000 for primary
  files; when a file approaches it, split by concern into `part` files
  (the established pattern: `agent_cli.dart`, `builtin_tools.dart`,
  `bin/fah.dart` → `bin/fah_*.dart`, `agent_service.dart` →
  `agent_service_*.dart` mixins) — never by extracting public API.
- `lib/src/approval/` — tool approval gate: tiers (read/write/exec),
  session modes (always-ask/write/yolo/autopilot — the CLI label of the
  `unattended` enum), per-tool overrides,
  critical-pattern
  `bash` interceptor, per-turn grants (`grantForTurn(allow:, deny:)` —
  skill `allowed-tools`/`disallowed-tools` manifest keys ride these for one
  turn; explicit deny > turnDeny > per-tool override > turnAllow >
  alwaysAllow > mode (critical bash outranks mode in always-ask/write/yolo,

  "key": "pr-1623",
  "fields": {
    "summary": "fix(1622): shell_job_registry persist window strands live jobs off the record on crash",
    "description": "## Problem
Nightly PTY red: `test/integration/job_board_stability_pty_test.dart:420` "restart with live jobs shows lost, never running" expects `5 background tasks lost`, got `✗ 1 background task lost on restart (process gone, no exit reported)` (run 38676570867, main 28927a1b0f). Green in the Oct-13/14 nightlies.

## Root cause
Culprit: 872f3ccc47 (gh-1590/#1594 — session JSONL diet). Its `LedgerSnapshotThrottle` (30 s `ledgerSnapshotPersistInterval`) rate-bounds `shell_job_registry` appends in `_persistJobBoard`: only the first board mutation in a window appends; the rest coalesce behind a trailing flush (real 30 s Timer) or the graceful shutdown flush. A SIGKILL runs neither. The PTY scenario launches 5 jobs inside one window then `hardKill`s — the file's last snapshot carries only job 1, so `_rehydrateJobBoard` demotes 1 live card to lost. Not a compaction/repair eviction: `repairKeepLatestCustomTypes` and the resume-time reader keep the LATEST snapshot; the records never reached the file. Pre-#1594 every mutation appended, which is why the baseline was green.

## Fix
Live-set GROWTH (a job started) bypasses the persist window — each start appends immediately, so the last snapshot always carries every started job and the invariant `lost == seeded live` holds. Settles keep riding the window: an unpersisted settle only overcounts `lost` on a crash (conservative — still never "running"). The gh-1590 diet stays in force for terminal churn; its wiring-test pin is revised to `<= starts + 1` with rationale.

- **Author**: vabhzw17eg2qu4m9-bit

- **State**: open
- **Files Changed**: 3
- **Additions**: +117
- **Deletions**: -9
- **Created**: 2026-10-15T04:09:00Z
- **Updated**: 2026-10-15T04:18:06Z

## PR Description

## Problem
Nightly PTY red: `test/integration/job_board_stability_pty_test.dart:420` "restart with live jobs shows lost, never running" expects `5 background tasks lost`, got `✗ 1 background task lost on restart (process gone, no exit reported)` (run 38676570867, main 28927a1b0f). Green in the Oct-13/14 nightlies.

## Root cause
Culprit: 872f3ccc47 (gh-1590/#1594 — session JSONL diet). Its `LedgerSnapshotThrottle` (30 s `ledgerSnapshotPersistInterval`) rate-bounds `shell_job_registry` appends in `_persistJobBoard`: only the first board mutation in a window appends; the rest coalesce behind a trailing flush (real 30 s Timer) or the graceful shutdown flush. A SIGKILL runs neither. The PTY scenario launches 5 jobs inside one window then `hardKill`s — the file's last snapshot carries only job 1, so `_rehydrateJobBoard` demotes 1 live card to lost. Not a compaction/repair eviction: `repairKeepLatestCustomTypes` and the resume-time reader keep the LATEST snapshot; the records never reached the file. Pre-#1594 every mutation appended, which is why the baseline was green.

## Fix
Live-set GROWTH (a job started) bypasses the persist window — each start appends immediately, so the last snapshot always carries every started job and the invariant `lost == seeded live` holds. Settles keep riding the window: an unpersisted settle only overcounts `lost` on a crash (conservative — still never "running"). The gh-1590 diet stays in force for terminal churn; its wiring-test pin is revised to `<= starts + 1` with rationale.

## Gates
- `dart analyze` clean on touched files (lib/src/cli/agent_cli.dart, lib/src/cli/agent_hub_cli.dart, test/cli/shell_job_ledger_throttle_wiring_test.dart); `dart format` applied.
- `test/cli/shell_job_ledger_throttle_wiring_test.dart` 3/3 green, incl. a new crash-moment regression test (real AgentCli, frozen `ledgerClock`: at the SIGKILL-equivalent point the session file must already carry all 5 jobs as running). Verified the new test FAILS pre-fix (lib change stashed) and passes post-fix.
- `shell_job_ledger_caps_test.dart` + `subagent_registry_caps_test.dart` 18/18 green.
- The PTY repro itself needs a real pty (`openpty` is blocked in this dev sandbox) — CI nightly is its gate.

Closes #1622

  GROUPED APPEND-ONLY export sections, one `// ── <subsystem> ──` comment
  header per group, exports sorted by path within a group, new exports
  appended to their subsystem group (a new subsystem starts a new group).
  No per-subsystem mini-barrels, no re-sorting of existing lines — append
  only, so parallel edits almost never touch the same line.

    "summary": "fix(1622): shell_job_registry persist window strands live jobs off the record on crash",
    "description": "## Problem
Nightly PTY red: `test/integration/job_board_stability_pty_test.dart:420` "restart with live jobs shows lost, never running" expects `5 background tasks lost`, got `✗ 1 background task lost on restart (process gone, no exit reported)` (run 38676570867, main 28927a1b0f). Green in the Oct-13/14 nightlies.

## Root cause
Culprit: 872f3ccc47 (gh-1590/#1594 — session JSONL diet). Its `LedgerSnapshotThrottle` (30 s `ledgerSnapshotPersistInterval`) rate-bounds `shell_job_registry` appends in `_persistJobBoard`: only the first board mutation in a window appends; the rest coalesce behind a trailing flush (real 30 s Timer) or the graceful shutdown flush. A SIGKILL runs neither. The PTY scenario launches 5 jobs inside one window then `hardKill`s — the file's last snapshot carries only job 1, so `_rehydrateJobBoard` demotes 1 live card to lost. Not a compaction/repair eviction: `repairKeepLatestCustomTypes` and the resume-time reader keep the LATEST snapshot; the records never reached the file. Pre-#1594 every mutation appended, which is why the baseline was green.

## Fix
Live-set GROWTH (a job started) bypasses the persist window — each start appends immediately, so the last snapshot always carries every started job and the invariant `lost == seeded live` holds. Settles keep riding the window: an unpersisted settle only overcounts `lost` on a crash (conservative — still never "running"). The gh-1590 diet stays in force for terminal churn; its wiring-test pin is revised to `<= starts + 1` with rationale.

- The PTY repro itself needs a real pty (`openpty` is blocked in this dev sandbox) — CI nightly is its gate.

Closes #1622"

# Pull Request Information

- **PR #**: 1623
- **URL**: https://github.com/IstiN/flutter_agent_harness/pull/1623
- **Title**: fix(1622): shell_job_registry persist window strands live jobs off the record on crash
- **Author**: vabhzw17eg2qu4m9-bit
- **Branch**: `fix/1622-job-board-restart-lost-count` → `main`
- **State**: open
- **Files Changed**: 3
- **Additions**: +117
- **Deletions**: -9
- **Created**: 2026-10-15T04:09:00Z
- **Updated**: 2026-10-15T04:18:06Z

## PR Description

## Problem
Nightly PTY red: `test/integration/job_board_stability_pty_test.dart:420` "restart with live jobs shows lost, never running" expects `5 background tasks lost`, got `✗ 1 background task lost on restart (process gone, no exit reported)` (run 38676570867, main 28927a1b0f). Green in the Oct-13/14 nightlies.

## Root cause
Culprit: 872f3ccc47 (gh-1590/#1594 — session JSONL diet). Its `LedgerSnapshotThrottle` (30 s `ledgerSnapshotPersistInterval`) rate-bounds `shell_job_registry` appends in `_persistJobBoard`: only the first board mutation in a window appends; the rest coalesce behind a trailing flush (real 30 s Timer) or the graceful shutdown flush. A SIGKILL runs neither. The PTY scenario launches 5 jobs inside one window then `hardKill`s — the file's last snapshot carries only job 1, so `_rehydrateJobBoard` demotes 1 live card to lost. Not a compaction/repair eviction: `repairKeepLatestCustomTypes` and the resume-time reader keep the LATEST snapshot; the records never reached the file. Pre-#1594 every mutation appended, which is why the baseline was green.

## Fix
Live-set GROWTH (a job started) bypasses the persist window — each start appends immediately, so the last snapshot always carries every started job and the invariant `lost == seeded live` holds. Settles keep riding the window: an unpersisted settle only overcounts `lost` on a crash (conservative — still never "running"). The gh-1590 diet stays in force for terminal churn; its wiring-test pin is revised to `<= starts + 1` with rationale.

## Gates
- `dart analyze` clean on touched files (lib/src/cli/agent_cli.dart, lib/src/cli/agent_hub_cli.dart, test/cli/shell_job_ledger_throttle_wiring_test.dart); `dart format` applied.
- `test/cli/shell_job_ledger_throttle_wiring_test.dart` 3/3 green, incl. a new crash-moment regression test (real AgentCli, frozen `ledgerClock`: at the SIGKILL-equivalent point the session file must already carry all 5 jobs as running). Verified the new test FAILS pre-fix (lib change stashed) and passes post-fix.
- `shell_job_ledger_caps_test.dart` + `subagent_registry_caps_test.dart` 18/18 green.
- The PTY repro itself needs a real pty (`openpty` is blocked in this dev sandbox) — CI nightly is its gate.

Closes #1622

Green in the Oct-13/14 nightlies.

## Root cause
Culprit: 872f3ccc47 (gh-1590/#1594 — session JSONL diet). Its `LedgerSnapshotThrottle` (30 s `ledgerSnapshotPersistInterval`) rate-bounds `shell_job_registry` appends in `_persistJobBoard`: only the first board mutation in a window appends; the rest coalesce behind a trailing flush (real 30 s Timer) or the graceful shutdown flush. A SIGKILL runs neither. The PTY scenario launches 5 jobs inside one window then `hardKill`s — the file's last snapshot carries only job 1, so `_rehydrateJobBoard` demotes 1 live card to lost. Not a compaction/repair eviction: `repairKeepLatestCustomTypes` and the resume-time reader keep the LATEST snapshot; the records never reached the file. Pre-#1594 every mutation appended, which is why the baseline was green.

## Fix
Live-set GROWTH (a job started) bypasses the persist window — each start appends immediately, so the last snapshot always carries every started job and the invariant `lost == seeded live` holds. Settles keep riding the window: an unpersisted settle only overcounts `lost` on a crash (conservative — still never "running"). The gh-1590 diet stays in force for terminal churn; its wiring-test pin is revised to `<= starts + 1` with rationale.

# pr-1623: fix(1622): shell_job_registry persist window strands live jobs off the record on crash

## Description

## Problem
Nightly PTY red: `test/integration/job_board_stability_pty_test.dart:420` "restart with live jobs shows lost, never running" expects `5 background tasks lost`, got `✗ 1 background task lost on restart (process gone, no exit reported)` (run 38676570867, main 28927a1b0f). Green in the Oct-13/14 nightlies.

## Root cause
Culprit: 872f3ccc47 (gh-1590/#1594 — session JSONL diet). Its `LedgerSnapshotThrottle` (30 s `ledgerSnapshotPersistInterval`) rate-bounds `shell_job_registry` appends in `_persistJobBoard`: only the first board mutation in a window appends; the rest coalesce behind a trailing flush (real 30 s Timer) or the graceful shutdown flush. A SIGKILL runs neither. The PTY scenario launches 5 jobs inside one window then `hardKill`s — the file's last snapshot carries only job 1, so `_rehydrateJobBoard` demotes 1 live card to lost. Not a compaction/repair eviction: `repairKeepLatestCustomTypes` and the resume-time reader keep the LATEST snapshot; the records never reached the file. Pre-#1594 every mutation appended, which is why the baseline was green.

## Fix
Live-set GROWTH (a job started) bypasses the persist window — each start appends immediately, so the last snapshot always carries every started job and the invariant `lost == seeded live` holds. Settles keep riding the window: an unpersisted settle only overcounts `lost` on a crash (conservative — still never "running"). The gh-1590 diet stays in force for terminal churn; its wiring-test pin is revised to `<= starts + 1` with rationale.

## Gates
- `dart analyze` clean on touched files (lib/src/cli/agent_cli.dart, lib/src/cli/agent_hub_cli.dart, test/cli/shell_job_ledger_throttle_wiring_test.dart); `dart format` applied.
- `test/cli/shell_job_ledger_throttle_wiring_test.dart` 3/3 green, incl. a new crash-moment regression test (real AgentCli, frozen `ledgerClock`: at the SIGKILL-equivalent point the session file must already carry all 5 jobs as running). Verified the new test FAILS pre-fix (lib change stashed) and passes post-fix.
- `shell_job_ledger_caps_test.dart` + `subagent_registry_caps_test.dart` 18/18 green.
- The PTY repro itself needs a real pty (`openpty` is blocked in this dev sandbox) — CI nightly is its gate.

Closes #1622

    "summary": "fix(1622): shell_job_registry persist window strands live jobs off the record on crash",
    "description": "## Problem
Nightly PTY red: `test/integration/job_board_stability_pty_test.dart:420` "restart with live jobs shows lost, never running" expects `5 background tasks lost`, got `✗ 1 background task lost on restart (process gone, no exit reported)` (run 38676570867, main 28927a1b0f). Green in the Oct-13/14 nightlies.

## Root cause
Culprit: 872f3ccc47 (gh-1590/#1594 — session JSONL diet). Its `LedgerSnapshotThrottle` (30 s `ledgerSnapshotPersistInterval`) rate-bounds `shell_job_registry` appends in `_persistJobBoard`: only the first board mutation in a window appends; the rest coalesce behind a trailing flush (real 30 s Timer) or the graceful shutdown flush. A SIGKILL runs neither. The PTY scenario launches 5 jobs inside one window then `hardKill`s — the file's last snapshot carries only job 1, so `_rehydrateJobBoard` demotes 1 live card to lost. Not a compaction/repair eviction: `repairKeepLatestCustomTypes` and the resume-time reader keep the LATEST snapshot; the records never reached the file. Pre-#1594 every mutation appended, which is why the baseline was green.

## Fix
Live-set GROWTH (a job started) bypasses the persist window — each start appends immediately, so the last snapshot always carries every started job and the invariant `lost == seeded live` holds. Settles keep riding the window: an unpersisted settle only overcounts `lost` on a crash (conservative — still never "running"). The gh-1590 diet stays in force for terminal churn; its wiring-test pin is revised to `<= starts + 1` with rationale.

- The PTY repro itself needs a real pty (`openpty` is blocked in this dev sandbox) — CI nightly is its gate.

Closes #1622"

  header per group, exports sorted by path within a group, new exports
  appended to their subsystem group (a new subsystem starts a new group).
  No per-subsystem mini-barrels, no re-sorting of existing lines — append
  only, so parallel edits almost never touch the same line.

    "description": "## Problem
Nightly PTY red: `test/integration/job_board_stability_pty_test.dart:420` "restart with live jobs shows lost, never running" expects `5 background tasks lost`, got `✗ 1 background task lost on restart (process gone, no exit reported)` (run 38676570867, main 28927a1b0f). Green in the Oct-13/14 nightlies.

## Root cause
Culprit: 872f3ccc47 (gh-1590/#1594 — session JSONL diet). Its `LedgerSnapshotThrottle` (30 s `ledgerSnapshotPersistInterval`) rate-bounds `shell_job_registry` appends in `_persistJobBoard`: only the first board mutation in a window appends; the rest coalesce behind a trailing flush (real 30 s Timer) or the graceful shutdown flush. A SIGKILL runs neither. The PTY scenario launches 5 jobs inside one window then `hardKill`s — the file's last snapshot carries only job 1, so `_rehydrateJobBoard` demotes 1 live card to lost. Not a compaction/repair eviction: `repairKeepLatestCustomTypes` and the resume-time reader keep the LATEST snapshot; the records never reached the file. Pre-#1594 every mutation appended, which is why the baseline was green.

## Fix
Live-set GROWTH (a job started) bypasses the persist window — each start appends immediately, so the last snapshot always carries every started job and the invariant `lost == seeded live` holds. Settles keep riding the window: an unpersisted settle only overcounts `lost` on a crash (conservative — still never "running"). The gh-1590 diet stays in force for terminal churn; its wiring-test pin is revised to `<= starts + 1` with rationale.

- The PTY repro itself needs a real pty (`openpty` is blocked in this dev sandbox) — CI nightly is its gate.

# AGENTS.md

Conventions for AI agents and contributors in this repository. Keep it

  mirrors it. `prompts/` — all LLM prompts as Markdown (see rules below).

  GROUPED APPEND-ONLY export sections, one `// ── <subsystem> ──` comment
  header per group, exports sorted by path within a group, new exports
  appended to their subsystem group (a new subsystem starts a new group).
  No per-subsystem mini-barrels, no re-sorting of existing lines — append
  only, so parallel edits almost never touch the same line.
- God-file ceiling (gh-1232): no Dart file over 2800 lines anywhere
  (crap4dart `loc` gate, `max_lines: 2800` — issue #1234 migrated the
  shell guards; enforced whole-tree in CI and on staged files by the
  pre-commit hook. Scope: core `lib bin` via `crap4dart.yaml` +
  `test example` via the `crap4dart.loc-scope.yaml` companion config
  (0.11.0 has no per-gate sources override), flutter_app/lib via
  `flutter_app/crap4dart.yaml`).
  Target < 2000 for primary
  files; when a file approaches it, split by concern into `part` files
  (the established pattern: `agent_cli.dart`, `builtin_tools.dart`,

  `agent_service_*.dart` mixins) — never by extracting public API.

  "key": "pr-1623",
  "fields": {
    "summary": "fix(1622): shell_job_registry persist window strands live jobs off the record on crash",
    "description": "## Problem
Nightly PTY red: `test/integration/job_board_stability_pty_test.dart:420` "restart with live jobs shows lost, never running" expects `5 background tasks lost`, got `✗ 1 background task lost on restart (process gone, no exit reported)` (run 38676570867, main 28927a1b0f). Green in the Oct-13/14 nightlies.

## Root cause
Culprit: 872f3ccc47 (gh-1590/#1594 — session JSONL diet). Its `LedgerSnapshotThrottle` (30 s `ledgerSnapshotPersistInterval`) rate-bounds `shell_job_registry` appends in `_persistJobBoard`: only the first board mutation in a window appends; the rest coalesce behind a trailing flush (real 30 s Timer) or the graceful shutdown flush. A SIGKILL runs neither. The PTY scenario launches 5 jobs inside one window then `hardKill`s — the file's last snapshot carries only job 1, so `_rehydrateJobBoard` demotes 1 live card to lost. Not a compaction/repair eviction: `repairKeepLatestCustomTypes` and the resume-time reader keep the LATEST snapshot; the records never reached the file. Pre-#1594 every mutation appended, which is why the baseline was green.

## Fix
Live-set GROWTH (a job started) bypasses the persist window — each start appends immediately, so the last snapshot always carries every started job and the invariant `lost == seeded live` holds. Settles keep riding the window: an unpersisted settle only overcounts `lost` on a crash (conservative — still never "running"). The gh-1590 diet stays in force for terminal churn; its wiring-test pin is revised to `<= starts + 1` with rationale.

## Gates
- `dart analyze` clean on touched files (lib/src/cli/agent_cli.dart, lib/src/cli/agent_hub_cli.dart, test/cli/shell_job_ledger_throttle_wiring_test.dart); `dart format` applied.
- `test/cli/shell_job_ledger_throttle_wiring_test.dart` 3/3 green, incl. a new crash-moment regression test (real AgentCli, frozen `ledgerClock`: at the SIGKILL-equivalent point the session file must already carry all 5 jobs as running). Verified the new test FAILS pre-fix (lib change stashed) and passes post-fix.
- `shell_job_ledger_caps_test.dart` + `subagent_registry_caps_test.dart` 18/18 green.
- The PTY repro itself needs a real pty (`openpty` is blocked in this dev sandbox) — CI nightly is its gate.

Closes #1622"
  }

    "summary": "fix(1622): shell_job_registry persist window strands live jobs off the record on crash",
    "description": "## Problem
Nightly PTY red: `test/integration/job_board_stability_pty_test.dart:420` "restart with live jobs shows lost, never running" expects `5 background tasks lost`, got `✗ 1 background task lost on restart (process gone, no exit reported)` (run 38676570867, main 28927a1b0f). Green in the Oct-13/14 nightlies.

## Root cause
Culprit: 872f3ccc47 (gh-1590/#1594 — session JSONL diet). Its `LedgerSnapshotThrottle` (30 s `ledgerSnapshotPersistInterval`) rate-bounds `shell_job_registry` appends in `_persistJobBoard`: only the first board mutation in a window appends; the rest coalesce behind a trailing flush (real 30 s Timer) or the graceful shutdown flush. A SIGKILL runs neither. The PTY scenario launches 5 jobs inside one window then `hardKill`s — the file's last snapshot carries only job 1, so `_rehydrateJobBoard` demotes 1 live card to lost. Not a compaction/repair eviction: `repairKeepLatestCustomTypes` and the resume-time reader keep the LATEST snapshot; the records never reached the file. Pre-#1594 every mutation appended, which is why the baseline was green.

## Fix
Live-set GROWTH (a job started) bypasses the persist window — each start appends immediately, so the last snapshot always carries every started job and the invariant `lost == seeded live` holds. Settles keep riding the window: an unpersisted settle only overcounts `lost` on a crash (conservative — still never "running"). The gh-1590 diet stays in force for terminal churn; its wiring-test pin is revised to `<= starts + 1` with rationale.

- `shell_job_ledger_caps_test.dart` + `subagent_registry_caps_test.dart` 18/18 green.
- The PTY repro itself needs a real pty (`openpty` is blocked in this dev sandbox) — CI nightly is its gate.

Closes #1622"

content.text:
Review complete. **PR #1623 — APPROVE** (0 blocking, 0 important, 1 suggestion).

## What I verified

- **Root cause & fix correctness**: Traced `LedgerSnapshotThrottle`/`LedgerSnapshotDeduper` (`lib/src/session/ledger_caps.dart`), `_persistJobBoard`, `_rehydrateJobBoard`, and `ShellJobBoard.toRecords/latestRecords/rehydrated`. The grewLive gate is sound: job ids are unique (`sh-<n>-<micros><rand>`, no reuse), growth always changes the payload so the deduper can never suppress it, the bypass re-owns the window via `confirmPersisted()` (clearing any pending trailing flush), and the error path fails open (stale liveIds only make detection *more* eager). Settles staying in the window is correctly conservative (overcounts `lost`, never fabricates "running").
- **Author's "fails pre-fix" claim independently reproduced**: reverting only `lib/src/cli/agent_hub_cli.dart` to parent 28927a1b0 makes the new crash-moment test fail with a 1-job snapshot (`has length of <1>` — the exact nightly symptom); restored, it passes.
- **Gates reproduced**: `dart analyze` clean on the 3 touched files, `dart format` clean, wiring test 3/3, caps tests 18/18.
- **The one finding (💡)**: `_jobBoardPersistedLiveIds = null` sits after the `if (latest.isEmpty) return;` in `_rehydrateJobBoard`, so a session switch to a registry-less session inherits the previous session's live ids — contradicting the invariant the throttle reset documents two lines above. Benign fail-open; posted as a suggestion anchored on diff line 539.

Outputs written: `outputs/pr_review.json`, `outputs/pr_review_general.md`, `outputs/pr_review_comments/comment1.md` (no `response.md`, per instructions).
